tei:div.tei:p: "$ (329)༄༅// lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gzhung ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba'i khrid yig sbas don kun gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(330)༄༅// oṃ swa sti// lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gzhung ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba'i khrid yig sbas pa'i don gsal ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mthu stobs dbang phyug birba pa yi gsung*// snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa rdo rje'i tshig /gsang mdzod sgyur byed gzhan la legs ston pa'i// bla ma lhag pa'i lhar bcas la btud nas// gdams pa mchog 'di nub par mi 'gyur zhing*// rang dga'i dri mas gos pa bsal ba'i phyir// gzhan la brtse ba'i bsam pas gsol btab nas// brgyud pa'i srol bzhin khrid rim gsal bar bya// de la slob ma dad pa dang snying rje dang ldan zhing dbang legs par thob pa 'khor ba'i duḥkha las thar bar 'dod cing*/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgo nas thams cad mkhyen pa thob par 'dod pas bla ma la tshogs gtor sngon du 'gro bas khrid yon phul te/ maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba gdab ste/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gyis// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin skyobs// khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni// gtso bos gzhan la skyabs ma mchis// 'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen gyis// blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod// (331)ces pa'i tshig lan gcig gis so// yang lag tu me tog brim/ phyag gsum 'tshal la me tog bla ma'i phyag tu phul la gsol ba lan gcig gdab/ yang de lta bu gcig ste lan gsum gyi rjes la/ bla ma rin po che'i spyan snga nas bdag cag 'dir 'dus pa gdul byar gyur pa'i slob ma rnams la shin tu zab pa'i khrid kyi rim pa rjes su bzung ste bka' drin nod par 'tshal lo zhes brjod/ maṇ+ḍal phyag tu phul nas gral du 'khod pa la/ bla mas gsol ba gdab pa la sogs pa 'di rnams slob dpon gyi che thabs tshol ba'am/ ge blo lta bu gcig min gyi/ sangs rgyas kyis rgyud sde rnams nas gsungs pa'i don grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi man ngag las 'byung ba yin te/

rim lnga las/ de nyid mi zab 'dod pa yis// shin tu gces pa gang dang gang*// shin tu khyad par can nyid dag /de dang de ni bla mar dbul// yang*/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas// bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam// de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i// ye shes mchog ni 'thob par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ de nyid du/ gang gis slob dpon gsol ma btab// 'dir ni rigs su skye ba med// ces dang*/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ dkyil 'khor me tog bcas thal mos// (332)nyan sogs 'dod pas gsol gsum gdab/ ces gsungs pas so// zhes brjod do// de'i tshe bla mas ltas brtag par bya ste/ dpon slob gnyis ka'i rlung g.yas nas rgyu ba'i dus su man ngag bstan na nyams myur du skye yang mi brtan zhing bar chad 'byung la/ gnyis ka nas rgyu na ma ning gi rlung zhes pa 'pho mtshams yin pas de'i tshe ting nge 'dzin gsha' ma mi skye bas mi brtan zhing*/ g.yon nas rgyu ba'i tshe bstan na nyams skye bu la yang skyes pa brtan zhing bar chad chung bas de dus bstan no// de'ang yun ring por g.yas su rgyu na g.yon du 'pho bar bsgom pas 'pho srid la/ ma 'phos na nu ma gcud la bor ba zhes bya ba/ lag g.yas pa'i gru mos nu ma mnye/ lag mthil gyis 'gram pa g.yas la mnye zhing gnyis ka'ang drag tu byas pas 'pho// des kyang 'phor ma nyan na/ zhag gcig gnyis la sogs// zhog g.yas 'og tu bcug ste nu ma gcud la bor ba'i sbyor ba byas pas 'pho'o// de'i tshe khrid kyi rim pa bstan par bya ste/ 'di la sngon du 'gro ba dang*/ dngos gzhi lam sgom pa gnyis kyi dang po la khrid kyi sngon 'gro dang*/ thun gyi sngon 'gro'o// dang po la'ang bsag sbyang gnyis bsgom pa dang*/ sbyong ba gsum nyams su blang ba'o// dang po la gnyis las/ tshogs bsags pa'i phyir maṇ+ḍal dbul ba ni/ gsang 'dus las/ zhing 'di rin chen bdun rnams kyis// mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste// dngos grub 'dod pas dngos grub phyir// shes rab can gyis nyin re dbul// zhes pa ltar nyams su blang ste/

bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba lan gsum sngon du song nas sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya// de'i don du bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom/ de nas swa bhā ba'i sngags kyis rang 'dug pa'i gnas stong (333)par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du rin po che'i khri chen po'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan steng na dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa he ru ka'i rang bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de'i mtha' mar bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba bzhugs par bsam/ dngos po rnam par dag pa me tog gtsang mas tshom bu bdun byas pa'i dbus/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar shel/ lhor bai*/ nub pad+ma rā ga/ byang gser las grub pa/ cog chen po brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes par byas pa dang*/ yang shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ shar dang dbus kyi bar du nyi ma/ dbus dang nub kyi bar du zla ba/ steng du lha dang mi'i longs spyod/ rin chen sna bdun/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog /dpag bsam gyi shing*/ gser dngul/ 'bru dang zas gos la sogs pa dngos po bzang la gya nom pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar bsam zhing*/ de ltos pa med par mdun gyi mgron rnams la phul bar bsams la/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma dam pas bdag gi rgyud la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ de lta bu bskyar la lan mang du dbul grangs bzung*/ bla ma la mos gus drag tu bya'o// gnyis pa 'gal rkyen sdig pa sbyong ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa'i bsnyen pa byed du gzhug ste/

de'ang spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin zhing yum rdo rje snyems ma gri gug dang thod pa (334)'dzin pa/ gnyis ka'ang sku mdog dkar po rin po che'i rgyan can skyil krung gis snyoms par zhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hūm̐ dkar po bsgoms la de las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum gang de las char bab pa bzhin rang gi spyi bo nas mar byung ste/ sdig pa thams cad nag po'i rnam par bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis ded pas dri ma'i lam gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon/ shul thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis nges par bsams la yi ge brgya pa bzla'o// de ltar bsags sbyang gnyis thun re la brgya stong la sogs pa'i tshul gyis thun gsum mam bzhi'i rim pas rab kyis lo// 'bring gis zla ba/ tha mas kyang zhag gsum lnga bdun gyi bar ram sdig pa dag pa'i rtags khrus byas pa dang*/ lus la rnag khrag dang*/ mi gtsang ba dang*/ sems can la sogs pa 'thon pa dang*/ gos dkar po gon pa dang*/ rgyan dang me tog dkar pos brgyan pa dang*/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba la sogs pa rmi ba dang*/ dngos su lus yang ba dang*/ khams bde ba dang*/ shes pa dwangs shing ting nge 'dzin gsal ba 'byung ngo*// bsod nams 'phel ba'i rtags ni/ rang khri chen po la 'dug pa dang*/ gos gsar pa bzang po gyon pa dang*/ zas bzang po zos pa dang*/ rgyan bzang pos brgyan pa dang*/ nyi zla shar ba dang*/ ri bo chen po la 'dzeg pa dang*/ rnga brdung ba dang*/ dung 'bud pa dang*/ kun gyis bstod pa la sogs pa rmi lam du ma byung bar du bya zhing*/ bsag sbyang gnyis mang gin ting nge 'dzin skye sla zhing gegs chung ba yin no// de ltar bsag sbyang gnyis ka'i grangs bzung la grangs dang me tog bla ma la dbul/ bla mas ltas brtag ste grangs kha 'cham na bar chad che zhing ting nge 'dzin ngan pas (335)slar bsag sbyang la 'bad du gzhug

/kha yar na bar chad chung zhing ting nge 'dzin bzang bas thun spo'o/// /gnyis pa sbyang ba gsum nyams su blang ba la gsum las/ lus sbyang ba ni/ lus thams cad chang ngam dri chus bkrus la/ bku mnye bya/ nyi ma la bdug /gnas khang dben sar bsdad cing rdul mi thon tsam du ran par bcag /bskor ba bya/ de nas/ mgo bo mjing pa bsgyur bya zhing*// lag pa gnyis ni so sor bsal// rkang pa gnyis kyang drag tu sprug /yan lag lnga yi sbyang ba'o// zhes pa ltar nyams su blang ste/ mgo bo la g.yas g.yon du bskor ba gnyis/ phyogs bzhir 'phang ba dang*/ g.yas g.yon du 'phang ba gnyis te bzhi'o// de'ang rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bsnol nas mig mi 'dzum par bya ste/ btsum na mig la skyon 'ong bas so// lag pa la so sor sprug pa/ mgo bo la bskor nas rus gcig tu sprugs pa dang*/ ma bskor bar mdun tu pus mo'i steng du dus gcig sprugs pa dang*/ mda' gzhu 'gengs pa ste bzhi'o// rkang pa phyogs bzhir sprugs pa res mos su byed pa bzhi ste/ tshul de lta bu lus dub dub kyi bar du byas pas rtsa thams cad mnyen tu 'gro bas rtsa rlung gi zug drag po mi 'byung ba yin no// de nas lus ngag khong klod de gsal ba rang so bzung*/ lhug pa rang so bzung bar bya'o// dang po ni/ sems kyi mtshan nyid ngos bzung nas de'i steng du 'jog /gnyis pa ni/ sems kyi ngo bo'i steng du zung 'jug tu shes pas klod nas bzhag go /ngag sbyang ba ni/ kha ton dang bzlas brjod gleng slong la sogs pa ngag gi las bskyungs la mi smra bar 'dug pa ste/ des dbugs 'jam zhing bde bar 'gyur ro// yid sbyong ba ni/ lha sgom pa la sogs pa chos kyi bsam mno dang (336)mos gus dang snying rje la sogs pa yid la las mi 'chol bar skyo se bzhag /des sems dmigs pa la 'jug par 'gyur te/ mdor na lus kyi 'phrul 'khor gyis lus dang*/ ngag dben par gnas pas ngag dang*/

sems dal bar gnas pas sems sbyang ste/ de gsum ni rta rgyug pa'i sngon du sbyang khug byed pa dang 'dra ste/ de lta bu lo dang zla ba'i bar du byas pas ting nge 'dzin rang shugs kyis skye ba'ang srid de// tha mal pa yi lus ngag yid// sbyangs pas ye shes 'char bar 'gyur// zhes so// de ltar byas pas lus 'byongs pa'i rtags lus bde ba dang*/ ldang ba yang ba dang*/ lus gnad gang byas pa la yun ring du 'dug tshugs pa la sogs pa 'byung la/ ngag 'byongs pa'i rtags rlung 'gro 'ong mi tshor ba dang*/ phyi nang du mi rgyu ba la mi bde ba med pa la sogs pa dang*/ sems 'byongs pa'i rtags gsal zhing dwangs la gzhan tu mi 'phro ba la sogs pa 'byung bas rtags de dag ma byung gi bar sbyang ba la 'bad par bya'o/// /gnyis pa thun mong gi sngon 'gro la gnyis kyi/ dang po gnad la dbab pa rnam pa gsum las/ lus gnad la dbab pa ni/ lus skyil krung ngam tsog pu gang bde ba las skyil krung ltar na/ sems dpa'am rdo rje skyil krung ngam/ lag pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya bca'/ tsog bu ltar na rkang pa gnyis bsnol nas/ rkang pa gnyis snag po che dang gsum sgyed pu btsugs pa bzhin mnyam thangs btang*/ gcig la khal bkur na mi zug pa yin/ lag pa sgom thag gi phyag rgya'am thab 'gal gyi phyag rgya bca'/ de gnyis ka la mgo cung zad rgu/ mig sna rtser dbab/ lce rkan la sbyar/ so dang mchu mnyam par sbyar ro// de dag kyang na so rgan pa dang*/ nam zla ston dpyid dang*/ nad khrag mkhris dang*/ dro (337)ba dang*/ tsha ba shas che ba'i dus thams cad du gtsor skyil krung bya/ gzhon pa dang*/ nam zla dgun dang*// nad grang ba dang*/ bad kan shas che ba dang*/ grang ba thams cad du tsog pu la bslab po// de'ang lus gnad la phab pas rtsa mi 'khrugs/ des sems gnas pas ting nge 'dzin rang shugs kyis skye ste khang pa rtsigs pa'i 'gram dang 'dra'o// ngag gnad la dbab pa ni/

mgrin pa mi bde ba sangs kyis bar du sna sgo nas rlung drag tu phyir 'bud pa ste khang pa'i mi gtsang ba phyag dar byed pa dang 'dra'o// sems gnad la dbab pa ni/ dar cig sems lhod glod nas 'jog pa ste rta bang 'don khar dbugs 'don pa dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa sgom pa la gsum las/ dang po bsags pa'i las thams cad gzhan don du 'gyur ba dang*/ theg pa chen po'i lam du sgrub pa'i phyir byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu bdag gis sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du ting nge 'dzin bsgom snyam du bsam pa'o// gnyis pa tshogs rdzogs pa'i yan lag tu bla ma bsgom pa ni/ spyi bor pad zla nyi ma'i steng du bla ma bsgoms la mos gus drag tu byas shing*/ bdag gi rgyud la ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes snying thag pa nas yang dang yang du gsol ba gdab/ mthar mos gus byas la bla ma spyi bor bstim mo// gsum pa tha mal gyi rtog pa spang ba'i don du lha bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas srung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ yang hūm̐ zhes brjod pas dal rgyas pa'am/ he ru ka phyag gnyis pa gang rung bsgoms la lus la bar chad mi 'jug par bya ba'i phyir spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ ngag la bar chad mi 'jug par bya ba'i phyir (338)mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ yid la bar chad mi 'jug par bya ba'i phyir snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐ nag po bsams la/ ngag tu oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan gsum brjod de gsal btab pas bar chad bsrung ngo*// sbyang ba gsum/ gnad la dbab pa gsum/ sgom pa gsum ste bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu po de ni bsam gtan thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba yin no// gnyis pa lam gyi dngos gzhi la/ snang ba gsum gyis dkri ba dang*/ gzhung thams cad rgyud gsum du 'du bas rgyud gsum gyis dkri ba dang gnyis kyi dang po la ma dag pa'i snang ba nyams kyi snang ba dag pa'i snang bas dkri ba gsum gyi dang po ni/

rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ sems can la/ zhes gsungs pas/ sems can gyi khams la brtags pas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes pas thog mar 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa la/ zhes pas nyon mongs pa dug gsum che 'bring chung gsum du spyad pas ngan song gsum du khrid la/ de las thar ba'i dal 'byor ni rnyed par dka' bas/ de nas dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsgom pa dang*/ ma dag pa'i snang ba zhes pas ma dag pa 'khrul snang la brten nas las bsags pas/ de nas las rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa bsgom pa dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ 'khor ba pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab kyang*/ rigs bsdu na sdug bsngal gsum du 'dus pas duḥkha gyi dang*/ 'gyur ba'i dang*/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal sgom pa gsum gyi dang po la dmyal ba/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam pa gsum gyi dang po la/ tsha dmyal/ grang dmyal/ nyi tshe nyi 'khor gyi bsam pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ bshes spring du/ sems can nyes par spyad pa spyod rnams la// yang sos thig nag rab tu tsha ba dang*// bsdus (339)'joms ngu 'bod mnar med la sogs pa// dmyal ba rnams su rtag tu sdug bsngal gyur// zhes pa ltar/ yang sos/ thig nag /bsdus 'joms/ ngu 'bod/ ngu 'bod chen po/ tsha ba/ rab tu tsha ba/ mnar med pa rnams kyi sdug bsngal bzod blag med de/ yang sos pa rnams phan tshun dgra mi sha bo'i 'du shes kyis lag tu gang blangs pa mtshon char gyur te gcig la gcig brdeg pas srog chad pa dang*/ rlung grang mo langs pa'am/ nam mkha' las yang sos par gyur cig ces pa'i sgras lus sngar bzhin du sos pa dang*/ yang gcig la gcig rdeg pa la sogs pa snga ma bzhin du byed pas sdug bsngal lo// thig nag ni/ dmyal ba pa'i lus la thig bzhi'am brgyad la sogs pa btab ste/ de'i steng nas spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil bar du sog les 'dra ba dang*/ sta res gcod cing de'i tshe'ang lus kyi smad gtubs pa dang*/

stod kyi rma rnams 'tsho zhing stod gzhogs pa na smad kyi rma 'drub cing de lta bu'i sdug bsngal las ma zad bar du myong ngo*// bsdus 'joms ni/ ri lug dang*/ ra dang*/ rta'i gdong pa can la sogs pa'i bar du dmyal srung rnams kyis dmyal ba ba'i sems can rnams btsangs pa dang ri gnyis 'dus te til mar bzhin du 'tshir zhing phye mar byed la yang ri gnyis phyir gyed pa dang lus sngar bzhin du gyur nas/ yang phye mar byed pa'i sdug bsngal myong ngo*// ngu 'bod ni/ khang pa zhig tu phyin pa na las kyi dbang gis lcags khang sgo med du gyur nas de'i nang me 'bar bas bsregs te shin tu nyen pas ngu zhing cho nges 'debs pa'i sdug bsngal myong ngo*// ngu 'bod chen po ni/ lcags khang nyis rim me 'bar bas bsregs pas cher ngus shing cho nges 'debs pa'i sdug bsngal myong ngo*// tsha ba ni/ lcags kyi (340)gsal shing me 'bar bas gshang lam nas spyi bo'i bar thal byung du phug nas/ bu ga rnams nas du ba 'thul ba dang me 'bar ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal myong ngo*// rab tu tsha ba ni/ lcags gyi gsal shing me 'bar ba rtse gsum yod pas dpung pa gnyis dang spyi bor phug nas lus kyi nang mer 'bar te mgrin pa dang kha nas me lce 'bar ba du ba dang bcas pa btud mar 'byung zhing lto ba gas nas nang khrol rnams lug pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal myong ngo*// mnar med ni/ phyogs bzhi steng 'og nas me 'bar bas dmyal ba'i lus ma dang tha mi dad gyur nas sreg pa'i sdug bsngal myong la de na sems can yod pa yang nyam thag pa'i skad 'byin pa las rjes su dpog pa ma gtogs rnam dbye tha dad du mtshon par mi nus la/ gzhan yang lcags zhib tu 'dags ma me 'bar ba dang lhan cig tu bkrab pa dang*/ lcags kyi snod du 'bru mar me 'bar ba'i nang du 'tshod pa dang*/ lcags kyi thang me 'bar bar lce brgyangs nas phur pas 'debs pa dang*/

khro chu bzhus pa'i khu ba ldud pa dang*/ bye ma me stags 'phro ba'i sa gzhir 'gror 'jug pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong ste/ dmyal ba phyi ma phyi ma rnams la snga ma snga ma'i sdug bsngal de snyed 'byung ba'i steng du rang rang gi sdug bsngal ya thon du myong la/ de dag yun ji srid gcig tu nyams su myong na/ mdzod du/ mi rnams lo ni lnga bcu na// 'dod pa dag gi lha rnams las// 'og ma dag gi nyin zhag gcig /yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin// 'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam// des na de dag rnams kyi tshe// 'dod pa'i lha dang 'dra ba yin// rab tu tsha phyed mnar med ni// bar gyi bskal par zhes 'byung bas rgyal chen rigs bzhi pas mi lo lnga bcu la zhag rer byas (341)pa'i lo lnga brgya/ sum cu rtsa gsum pas mi lo brgya la zhag rer byas pa'i lo stong*/ 'thab bral bas nyis brgya la zhag rer byas pa'i lo nyis stong*/ dga' ldan pas bzhi brgya la zhag rer byas pa'i lo bzhi stong*/ 'phrul dga' bas brgyad brgya la zhag rer byas pa'i brgyad stong*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pas mi lo stong drug brgya la zhag rer byas pa'i lo khri drug stong thub cing*/ lha de rnams kyi tshe la zhag rer byas pa'i lo grangs de snyed re yang sos la sogs pa drug gis rim pa ltar thub la/ rab tu tsha bas bar bskal phyed/ mnar med kyis bar bskal gcig thub bo// grang dmyal la/ chu bur can/ chu bur rdol ba can/ a chu zer ba/ kyi hud zer ba/ so tham tham pa/ ut+pal ltar gas pa/ pad+ma ltar gas pa/ pad+ma ltar cher gas pa ste brgyad yod la/ 'di rnams tsha dmyal rnams kyi thad ka na yod cing sdug bsngal gyi khyad par yang*/ dang po la khang khyim dang gos nyi ma la sogs pa dro ba'i rkyen med gangs ri chen po'i khrod na 'dug cing*/ rlung dang bu yug grang bas btab ste nyen pas lus chu bur gyis gang bar gyur ba'i sdug bsngal myong ngo*// gnyis pa ni/

grang drag pas chu bur yang rdol te de'i nang nas skyes pa'i lcags kyi 'bu mchu rnon gyis pags pa 'dral te/ de nas khrag dang chu ser 'dzag pa'i sdug bsngal myong ngo*// gsum pa ni/ grang bas nyen nas bsran ma bzod par a chu zer ba'i skad drag pos cho nges 'debs pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ grang bas nyen nas lus sems 'bral ba ltar gyur cing mig sna nas chu ser 'dzag cing lkog ma skams te skad shib shib pos kyi hud zer ba'i smre sngags 'don pa'i sdug bsngal myong ngo*// lnga pa ni/ grang drag pas skad kyang (342)mi thon par shin tu nyen nas kos thag thag so tam tam byed pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ drug pa ni/ de bas kyang nyen pas lhags pa'i shugs kyis lus sngon por gyur te kha lnga'am drug tu gyes pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ bdun pa ni/ de bas kyang cher lhags pas gdungs pas pags pa'i mdog dmar po khrag zad la khad par 'gyur te/ tshal pa brgyad dam bcur gyes pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ brgyad pa ni/ de bas kyang grang bas pags pa shus te dmar por gyur pa kha brgya'am stong la sogs par gas nas de dag las zhag chu ser rkang mar la sogs pa 'dzag pa'i sdug bsngal myong ste/ slob spring du/ lhags pa dpe med rus pa la yang thim pa yis// lus bred 'dar shing bskur ba kum kum por 'dug pa// chu bur brgya byung ba rdol ba las byung srog chags kyis// ral gris dbang nas zhag dang chu ser rkang bcas 'dzag /kos thag so 'thams skra dang spu rnams med gyur pa// mig dang rna ba lkog ma gnod pas kun gzings shing*// lus dang sems kyi bar dag rab tu glang gyur nas// grang ba'i dmyal bar gnas shing shin tu 'o dod 'bod// ces so// de dag gi tshe'i tshad kyang*/ mdzod du/ til sbyang nang nas lo brgya zhing*// til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa// chu bur can gyi tshe yin te// gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shu 'gyur// zhes pa'i 'grel par/

bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag gi tshe'i tshad dpe tsam du/ dge slong dag /dper na 'di na yul ma ga dha'i til gyi sbyang khal brgyad cu pa zhig til gyis phyur bur bkang te/ de nas la la zhig gis lo brgya brgya 'das shing til re re bor na/ dge slong dag rim pa des na yul ma ga ta'i til gyi sbyang khal brgyad cu po de ma lus par yongs su zad par 'gyur ba ni ches myur gyi/ chu bur can du skyes pa'i tshe yongs su gtugs par ni nga mi smra'o zhes pa'i mdo drangs shing*/ (343)gzhan phyi ma phyi ma rnams nyi shu 'gyur du 'gres pa thub par bshad do// nye tshe nyi 'khor gyi sdug bsngal bsams pa ni/ tsha dmyal brgyad kyi phyogs bzhi na/ me ma mur gyi 'obs/ ro myags kyi 'dam/ spu gri'i thang*/ ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal/ shal ma ri'i sdong po la sogs pa'i mtshon cha dang*/ chu klung rab med rnams su tsha ba'i dmyal ba pa rnams sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong ste/ mdzod du/ brgyad po kun las lhag bcu drug /de dag gi ni ngos bzhi na// me ma mur dang ro myags 'dam// spu gri'i lam sogs chu bo yin// zhes so// sdug bsngal ji lta bu myong na/ tsha ba'i dmyal ba pa rnams kyi tsha dmyal dngos gzhi las thar nas phyogs gzhan du phyin pa dang*/ me ma mur gyis gang ba'i 'obs nang du lhung nas rkang pa mnan pa na sha thams cad tshig nas rus par 'gyur zhing*/ btegs pa na sos la/ yang bzhag pa na 'tshig ste de lta bus yun du gnas so// de nas thar ba na phyi sa'i 'dam rul pa dri nga bas gang ba'i ro myags kyi 'dam du bying ste 'bu lcags kyi mchu can gyis za bas sdug bsngal lo// de las thar ba dang spu gri'i so rnon bltams pa'i thang la phyin te rkang pas mnan pa na dum bur byed cing btegs pa na sos par 'gyur la/ de nas thar nas ljon shing yid du 'ong bar snang ba'i drung du thang chad nas rgyug pa dang*/

lo ma rnams mtshon char gyur pa lhung nas lus gcod pa'i sdug bsngal myong la/ de nas thar pa dang lcags kyi khyi dang bong bu lce spyang la sogs pas ded nas bred de shal ma ri'i rtser mthong ba na myur tu 'dzegs pas lcags kyi tsher ma sor bcu drug pa kha thur du bltas pas lus dbang cing khong du nub pas sdug bsngal te rtse mor phyin pa dang*/ khwa ta dang*/ bya dkar dang*/ rgod lcags kyi mchu can gyis mig dag 'dru zhing sha 'thog pa rnams nyam thag (344)pas bar 'byin zhing*/ thur du bab pa na tsher ma rnams kha gyen du bltas te lus phug ste dran pa nyams pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal myong la/ de las thar ba dang*/ thal skyo me 'bar bas gang ba'i chu bo rab med du dmyal srung gis btab ste der yun ring du sdug bsngal lo// mdor na de dag tu skye ba'i thabs mi 'dug pas mi skye ba'i thabs la 'bad/ thabs kyang lam nyams su len pa yin la/ lam rnams kyi nang nas kyang mchog lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag 'di nyid yin pas 'di nyid rtse gcig tu nyams su blang snyam du bsam/ de ltar bsgoms pas lus sems kyi shugs chad pa dang khong klod la bzhag go /gnyis pa yi dwags kyi duḥkha bsam pa ni/ dmyal ba las thar nas gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes na yang duḥkha dpag tu med de/ 'di la phyi'i sgrib pa can/ nang gi sgrib pa can/ zas skom gyi sgrib pa can gsum gyi dang pos zas skom ci mthong ba thams cad rnag khrag la sogs mi gtsang bas gang ba'i chu dang*/ ma la ya'i tshal/ yang nags bsregs pa'i tshal la sogs pa phyin ci log 'ba' zhig tu snang ste/ slob spring du/ shin tu mi bzad las yongs smin pas rnam rmongs pa// 'di la sna tshogs 'di kun phyin ci log tu snang*// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ khab mig tsam gyi kha la dpag tshad tsam 'jigs pa'i// lto chen nyam thag rgya mtsho chen po'i chu 'thungs kyang*// mgul phug yangs pa nyid du phyin par mi 'gyur pa// kha yi dug gis chu thigs pa'ang skom par 'gyur// zhes pa ltar duḥkha myong la/

gsum pas ni/ bshes spring du/ kha cig mtshan zhing kha nas 'bar ba ste/ zas su 'bar ba'i khar 'bab bye ma 'tshal/ zhes pa ltar zas ci myong ba thams cad me 'bar bar gyur nas rgyu lto la sogs pa tshig pa'i duḥkha la sogs du ma myong ste/ de dag kyang zla ba la zhag tu brtsis pa'i lo brgya thub ste/ mdzod du/ yi dwags rnams (345)zla ba nyin zhag gi lnga brgya/ zhes pa ltar duḥkha ste/ der skye ba'i thabs med pas snga ma bzhin bsam mo// gsum pa dud 'gro'i duḥkha bsam pa ni/ dud 'gro la gnyis las/ bying na gnas pa rgya mtsho dang gling bar gyi mun pa na yod la/ kha 'thor ba ni/ lha dang ma'i gnas na yod de/ de dag la'ang bshes spring du/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang bsad pa dang*// bcings dang brdeg sogs duḥkha sna tshogs dang*// zhi 'gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni// gcig la gcig bza' shin tu mi bzad pa// kha gcig mu tig bal dang rus pa dang*// sha dang pags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur// dbang med gzhan dag rngog pa lag pa dang*// lcags dang lcags kyus gdab pas btab ste bkol// zhes so// de dag gi tshe tshad kyang*/ dud 'gro rnams mchog ring bskal pa'o// zhes mdzod du gsungs pa ltar duḥkha ste/ der skye ba'i thabs med pa snga ma bzhin bsam mo// gnyis pa 'gyur ba'i duḥkha bsam pa la gnyis kyi spyir thun mong du 'gyur ba'i duḥkha bsam pa ni/ 'khor ba'i bde ba ji tsam thob kyang mi brtan pas/ slar de dang bral nas duḥkha du ma myong dgos pa'i phyir snying po med de/ brgya byin du skyes nas slar sa steng du lhung ste duḥkha lang las nu lta bu dang*/ 'khor los sgyur bar skyes nas kun gyi tha mar skye ba dang*/ 'dod gzugs kyi lha'i bde ba thob nas dmyal bar skye ba dang*/ nyi zlar skyes nas kyang mun par 'jug pa la sogs pa 'gyur ba'i duḥkha dpag tu med de/ bshes spring du/ brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os gyur nas ni// las kyi dbang gis phyir yang sa steng lhung*// 'khor los sgyur ba nyid du gyur nas kyang*// 'khor ba dag tu yang bran nyid du 'gyur// zhes dang*/

lha yul 'dod bde shin tu chen po dang*// tshangs nyid (346)chags bral bde ba thob nas slar// mnar med me yi bud shing gyur pa yi// duḥkha rgyun mi 'chad pa bsten 'tshal lo// nyi ma zla ba thob nas rang lus kyi// 'od kyis 'jig rten mtha' dag snang byas te// slar yang mun nag smag tu phyin gyur nas// rang gi lag pa brkyang de'ang mthong mi 'gyur// zhes pa ltar der skye ba'i thabs med pa sogs snga ma bzhin no// gnyis pa bye brag tu mi'i 'gyur ba'i duḥkha bsam pa ni/ spyir 'khor ba na 'gyur ba'i duḥkha de lta bu yod kyang mngon du ma gyur pas yid mi ches su chug na'ang*/ sgos su mi la legs par brtags na phyugs po sprang por 'gro ba dang*/ kha drag po zhan por song ba/ dgrar gyur pa bshes dang*/ bshes su gyur pa dgrar song ba la sogs pa yul mi dang nye 'brel dang*/ rgyal khams kyi mi la bltas pas sngar gyi sa na med par rim pa bzhin 'gyur nas 'gro ste/ mdor na bsags pa kun gyi mthar 'dzad cing*// mthon po'i mtha' ni dma' ba yin// 'dus pa'i mtha' ni 'bral ba yin// zhes pa ltar der skye ba'i thabs med pa sogs snga ma bzhin no// gsum pa 'du byed kyi duḥkha bsam pa ni/ 'khor bar duḥkha spangs te bde ba bsgrub pa'i ched du longs spyod dang 'khor 'dab bsgrub pa'i bya ba la 'bad do snyam/ 'dod pa la chog mi shes pas gcig grub kyang gzhan dang gzhan yang don du gnyer bas rgas rgas shi shi las byas kyang tshims pa med la tshe rabs brgyud mar las byas su zin yang*/ las la zin pa ngang tshim pa med de/ bzhi brgya par/ las ni 'bad pas byed 'gyur zhing*// byas zin 'bad pa med par 'jig /de ltar gyur kyang chos la ko /las la chags bral 'ga' yod min// zhes so// der skye ba'i thabs med pa sogs snga ma bzhin te/ de ltar bsam pas 'gro ba (347)gang du skyes kyang skyid med pa'i bsams pa la thag chod na ci byas chos su 'gro ba yin no// gnyis pa dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba/

phan 'dogs che ba/ yun ring du mi gnas pa bsam pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ duḥkha can gyi 'khor ba der mi skye ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos shing*/ de sgrub pa'i rten yang dal 'byor gyi lus 'di nyid yin la/ dal 'byor yang*/ bshes spring du// log par lta ba 'dzin pa dud 'gro nyid/ yi dwags nyid dang dmyal bar skye ba nyid// rgyal ba'i bka' med pa dang mtha' 'khob tu// kla klor skye dang glen zhing lkugs pa nyid// tshe ring lha nyid gang yang rung bar ni// skye ba zhes bgyi mi khoms skyon brgyad do// zhes pa rnams spangs shing*/ mi nyid dang*/ yul dbus su skyes pa dang*/ dbang po tshang ba/ gnas la dad pa ste 'dul ba la gus pa dang*/ las mtha' ma log pa ni mtshams med pa lnga rang gis ma byas shing gzhan byed du ma bcug pa ste rang 'byor lnga dang*/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa/ des chos gsungs pa/ de'i bstan pa gnas pa/ bstan pa la 'jug pa gzhan yang yod pa/ gzhan gyi phyir sbyin bdag sogs rjes su snying brtse ba'i gzhan 'byor lnga ni/ 'byor pa bcu dang ldan pa'o// 'di nyid shin tu rnyed dka' ste/ spyod 'jug tu/ de nyid phyir na bcom ldan gyis// rgya mtsho cher g.yengs gnya' shing gi /bu gar ru sbal mgrin chud ltar// mi nyid shin tu thob dka' gsungs// zhes so// rnyed dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ sems can gyi khams la bltas na lus ma thob pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ lus thob pa la'ang mi lus ma thob pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ mi lus thob pa la'ang dal 'byor thob pa (348)srid pa tsam yin pas so// de bas rnyed dka' ba'i dal 'byor thob pa'i dus 'dir snying po blang dgos shing de'ang lam nyams su len pa nyid yin/ lam gyi mchog lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag 'di rtse gcig tu nyams su blang bsam pa'o// gnyis pa phan thogs che ba bsam pa ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' yang thob pa la dgos pa ci yod snyam na phan yon shin tu che ste/

dal 'byor gyi lus 'dis tshe phyi ma'i mtho ris/ theg pa 'og ma'i myang 'das/ rnam mkhyen gyi sangs rgyas kyang sgrub par nus pas shin tu phan 'dogs che ste/ slob spring du/ bde gshegs lam rten 'gro ba'i 'dren par chas gyur zhing*// sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa'i// lam de lha dang klu yis mi rnyed lha min dang*// mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi'am ci dang lto 'phyes min// mi yi dngos po shin tu rnyed dka' rnyed gyur nas// don du brnag pa gang yin de ni bstun te bsgrub/ ces pa ltar ro// gsum pa yun du mi gnas pa bsam pa la/ nges par 'chi ba/ nam 'chi cha med pa/ 'chi ba la cis kyang mi phan pa bsam pa dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ rnyed dka' ba'i dal 'byor de/ rtag pa'i chos can yin pas yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir lam sgrub pa la rings ci dgos snyam na/ dal 'byor la rtag pa'i dngos po cung zad kyang med de/ spyod 'jug tu/ nyin mtshan sdod par yongs med par// tshe ni rtag tu gud 'gyur zhing*// bsnon pa'ang gud nas yod med pas// bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur// zhes pa ltar/ nges par 'chi ba'i chos can yin te/ 'ga' zhig phyi nang gi 'byung ba 'khrugs pas 'chi/ 'ga' zhig log 'dren gyi bgegs 'khrugs pas 'chi// 'ga' zhig skyobs pa'i lha la sogs pa 'khrugs pas rkyen byas nas 'chi bas na sems can gyi rigs la mthar mi 'chi ba cung zad kyang med do// gnyis pa mthar 'chi'ang re zhig mi 'chi bar gnas pas da lta nyid du dal 'byor la snying po (349)blang ci dgos snyam na// spyod 'jug las/ de ring kho na mi 'chi zhes// bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin// zhes pa ltar nam 'chi cha med pas da lta nyid du lam nyams su blang dgos te/ de'i rgyu mtshan 'dzam bu gling pa'i tshe la nges pa med pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi rkyen mang ba dang*/ mthun pa'i rkyen dkon pas nam 'chi cha med de/

mdzod du/ 'di na ma nges tha mar ni// lo bcu dang po dpag tu med// ces dang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang ba ste// gson pa'i rkyen ni cung zad cig /de dag nyid kyang 'chi ba'i rkyen// de bas rtag tu chos mdzod cig /ces rin chen phreng ba las so// gsum pa ni 'chi ba na/ tshe 'dir bsags pa'i zas nor dang*/ bskyangs pa'i g.yog 'khor dang mdza' bshes la sogs pa rnams kyis phan yong snyam na/ nges par 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe zas nor la sogs pa'i rdzas kyis mi bzlog sngags kyis mi bzlog /rten 'brel gyis mi bzlog ste/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po chen po na ba ni nad med pa 'joms shing 'ong rga ba ni dar la bab pa 'joms shing 'ong*/ rgud pa ni phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'joms shing 'ong*// 'chi ba ni srog 'joms shing 'ong*/ de dag la mgyogs pas 'bros pa'am/ nor gyis bzlog pa'am/ rdzas dang sngags dang sman rnams kyis zhi bar bya sla ba ma yin no zhes so// gsum pa las rgyu 'bras la yid ches bsgom pa ni/ mi dge ba dang*/ dge ba dang*/ lung ma bstan gyi las 'bras bsam pa gsum gyi dang po mi dge ba'i las bsam pa ni/ srog gcod/ ma byin len/ 'dod log ste lus kyi las gsum dang*/ rdzun/ phra ma// tshig rtsub/ ngag 'khyal te ngag gi las bzhi dang*/ brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log lta ste yid kyi las gsum ste mi dge bcu dang*/ des thog drangs pa'i dug gsum gyis kun nas bslongs pa'i lus ngag gi las thams cad mi dge ba ste/ 'dod chags (350)zhe sdang gti mug gsum// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// zhes pa ltar ro// 'bras bu bsam pa ni/ mdzod du/ duḥkha phyir dang gsad phyir dang*// zi byin med phyir 'bras rnam gsum// zhes pa ltar/ srog gcod pas gsad bya duḥkha bskyed pa dang*/ gsad pa dang*/ gzi byin med par byas pas rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ngan song gsum du duḥkha/

rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu la/ byed pa rgyu mthun gang du skyes par srog gcod pa la dga'/ myong ba rgyu mthun tshe thung*/ bdag po'i 'bras bu phyi yi sman gzi mthu chung bar 'gyur ro// de bzhin du ma byin len sogs la yang 'bras bu gsum gsum 'byung ste mi dge ba che 'bring chung gsum du spyad pas rim pa ltar ngan song gsum du duḥkha rnam smin gyi 'bras bu dang*/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu las gang skyes su mi dge ba de dang de spyod pa la 'ga' ba byed pa rgyu mthun dang*/ rin chen phreng bar/ gsod pa yis ni tshe thung 'gyur// rku ba yis ni longs spyod phongs// byi bo bred pa dgra zlar bcas// rdzun du smra bas skur pa mang*// phra ma yis ni bshes dang dbye// tshig rtsub pos ni mi snyan thos// ma 'brel pas ni tshig mi btsun// brnab sems yid la re ba 'joms// gnod sems 'jigs pa sbyin par bshad// log par lta bas lta ngan nyid// ces pa rnams so// bdag po'i 'bras bu ni/ rim pa bzhin/ phyi rol mthu chung ser char mang*// rdul 'khrigs dri nga mtho dman can// tsha sgo can sogs dus log dang*// 'bras bu phra kha chung ba'am med// ces pa rnams so// gsum pa de spang bar bsam pa ni/ de ltar mi dge ba las 'bras bu duḥkha 'byung bar 'dug pas/ dus ring ba de nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar dang*/ ji srid ma shi'i bar dang*/ thung ba ji srid sang pa tsam gyi bar la sgo gsum gyi mi dge ba skad cig kyang mi spyad bsam mo// gnyis pa la dge ba'i las bsam pa ni/ gsad bya nas skur pa gdab pa'i bar mngon (351)du gyur kyang*/ mi gsod pa nas skur pa mi 'debs pa'i bar bcu ni dge ba bcu ste/ des gtsor byas pa'i ma chags pa/ zhe sdang med pa/ gti mug med pa'i dge rtsa gsum gyis kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi las thams cad dge ba ste/ chags sdang gti mug med las skyes// des bskyed las ni dge ba yin// zhes la ltar ro// gnyis pa 'bras bu bsam pa ni// dge ba spyad pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bus bde 'gror skye ba dang byang chub gsum thob pa yin la/

rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu la byed pa rgyu mthun gang du skyes pa der dge ba spyod pa la dga' ba dang myong ba rgyu mthun tshe ring ba la sogs pa bcu po yin zhing*/ bdag po'i 'bras bu sa phyogs gzi mdangs che ba la sogs pa bcu'o// gsum pa de bsgrub par bsams pa ni/ dge ba la phan yon de lta bu 'dug pas/ spyir da nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar dang*/ khyad par ji srid 'tsho'i bar dang*/ yang dgos sang da tsam gyi bar du sgo gsum dge ba dang mi 'bral bar bya snyam du bsam mo// gsum pa lung ma bstan gyi las bsam pa ni/ kun slong dge mi dge'i bsam pa gang gis kyang ma zin la/ 'bras bu dge mi dger lung bstan du med pa'i las zas za ba dang*/ 'gro 'chag la sogs pa'o// gnyis pa de'i 'bras bu bsam pa ni/ las de spyad kyang 'bras bu dge mi dge yid du 'ong mi 'ong gong yang 'byin mi nus so// gsum pa de dge bar bsgyur ba ni/ las de spyad kyang rnam smin mi bskyed pas 'khor ba las thar pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur bar 'dug pas/ ci nas kyang dge bar bsgyur snyam du bsams la/ sgo gsum gyi las ci byed thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis zin par byas te/ bzhi brgya par/ bsam pa byang chub sems dpa' la// dge ba'am gal te mi dge'ang rung*// thams cad dge legs nyid 'gyur te// gang phyir yid de'i dbang gyur phyir// zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa nyams kyi snang ba ni// rnal 'byor pa la ting nge 'dzin la nyams kyi snang ba zhes pas nyams kyi snang ba (352)bsgom pa dang*/ thun mong gi rnal 'byor pas thun mong gi nyams snang rgyud la skyes skyes sgom pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pas nyams skye 'gyur la nges shes skyes skyes bsgom pa gnyis kyi dang po la/ byams pa/ snying rje/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ 'jug par/ 'gro la phan par nyer sgrub pa// byams pa chen po zhes bya'o// zhes pa ltar bsams la/

gnyen/ dgra/ tha mal pa la byams pa bsgom pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ da ltar lus bskyed pa'i ma de nyid mdun du dmigs nas/ ma 'dis dang por mngal du nying mtshams sbyar te/ dka' ba brgyas kyang mi rnyed pa'i dal 'byor gyi sa la bzhag /de nas zla ba dgu'am bcu'i bar du ltor bzung nas gnod pa'i spyod lam spang*/ mthun pa'i rim gro brten/ mngal nas phyir thon pa na brtse sems kyis bag zon bcas te blangs nas nu zho bsnun/ bza' btung khas bsnyod/ mi gtsang ba lag gis phyis/ bdag gi don du sdig sdug gtam ngan du ma bsags nas/ ma rang la yod pa'i dngos po ci yod pa thams cad bdag la byin te/ mdor na gces pa'i lus gsos/ 'chi ba'i srog bskyabs/ phongs pa'i yo byad byin pas/ ma 'di shin tu drin che snyam du bsam/ de shes na drin can 'di la drin lan lan gyis blan dgos la/ ma blan na/ bdag las khrel bor ba su yang med de/ slob spring du/ byis pa pang na btsa' ba ci yang mi nus pas// gang gi nu zho byams pa'i shugs kyi gzag 'thungs pa// dal ba mang brten byams la brten pa de dag 'dir// shin tu ma rabs zhig na'ang su zhig spang bar spro// gang gis khong na 'di skabs rnyed nas gnas bcas shing*// gang gis brtse bag zon bcas sems kyis 'di blangs pa// nyon mongs de dag sdug bsngal skyabs med 'di bor nas// (353)'gro bar ma rabs tha shal zhig na'ang su zhig spro// zhes so// de ltar byas pas drin lan len na/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la sbyar na drin lon pas/ ma 'di gnas skabs lha mi dang mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi bde ba dang 'phrad na dga' snyam du bsam/ bde ba de yang rgyu dge ba ma bsags na mi thob pas/ bde ba'i rgyu dge ba'i las dang 'phrad na ci ma rung snyam du bsams la/ bdag gi ma 'di bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang 'phrad par gyur cig ces sgo gsum gyi 'jug pa rtse gcig tu dril la brgya'am stong la sogs pa bgrang*/

yang drin bsam zhing bgrang ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin bya ste/ lus kyi ba spu ldang ba'am mchi ma 'khrugs pa'i bar du bya'o// de nas pha ma la sogs pa'i gnyen rnams kyang mdun du dmigs la/ 'di rnams kyang da lta nye du 'brel ba'i sgo nas bdag la phan btags pas drin che la/ der ma zad skye ba snga mar bdag gi ma mang du byas shing*/ ma byas res kyis rtsa ba'i ma bzhin du phan btags pa la sogs pa bsam nas sngar bzhin du bgrang*/ de la rtsa ba'i ma bzhin du mar 'du shes nas/ byams pa bcos ma ma yin pa skyes pa na/ bdag la dngos dang brgyud pas gnod pa byed pa'i dgra bo gang yin mdun du dmigs la/ 'di smyon pa dang*/ rang dbang med par gyur nas/ bdag bur ma shes par da lta bdag la gnod pa byed kyang*/ skye ba snga ma'i ma yin pa sogs bsam la snga ma ltar byams pa bsgom/ de la skyes pa dang dgra gnyen du ma gyur pa'i nam mkhas khyab tshad kyi sems can rnams dmigs yul du byas la/ bshes spring du/ re re'i bdag nyid rus pa'i phung po ni// lhun po'i mnyam pa nyid cig 'das gyur te// ma yi thug mtha' rgya shugs tshig gu tsam// ril bur bgrangs kyang sa yis langs mi 'gyur// zhes pa'i tshul gyis sems can re res ma byas pa'i lan grangs la thug pa med cing*/ ma byas (354)res kyis phan btags pa la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan sngar bzhin bsams la byams pa bsgom mo// gnyis pa snying rje ni/ 'jug par/ duḥkha can rnams yongs skyob pa/ thugs rje chen po'i zhes bsgom pa la/ sems can dang*// chos la dmigs pa'i dang*/ dmigs pa med po'i snying rje bsgom pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ sems can mar gyur pa rnams bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang 'phrad na dga' ba las/ sems can gyi tshul de las log nas dngos su duḥkha gsum gyis gdungs shing duḥkha'i rgyu las mi dge ba la spyod pa 'di rnams snying re rje na snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsams la sems can mar gyur pa duḥkha yis gdungs pa 'di rnams snying re rje na zhes brgya stong gi bar du bgrang*/

cis snying rje na duḥkha yis gdungs pas snying rje ba yin pas duḥkha gsum dang*/ de'i rgyu mi dge ba spyod pa dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa dang*/ bdag gi ma 'di rnams duḥkha dang*/ duḥkha'i rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig ces brgya'am stong la sogs pa bgrang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi ma 'di rnams sems can nam gang zag gi bdag tu ma grub kyang ma rig pa las bdag dang sems can du btags te duḥkha bar gyur pa 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du bsam pa la sogs pa sngar bzhin snying rje bsgom mo// gsum pa ni/ sems can 'di dag rang bzhin gyis bden par grub pa ma yin yang*/ gang zag dang chos su bden par mngon par zhen pas 'khor bar 'khyams te duḥkha ba 'di dag snying re rje na zhes sogs sngar bzhin du bsgom pa'o// gsum pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la/ smon pa/ 'jug pa/ don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan du/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// ces pa ltar mar gyur pa'i sems can 'di thams cad duḥkha rgyu bcas las sgrol ba bdag bu la 'bab ste/ ma ma (355)bsgral bar bdag gcig pu thar bar byed na khrel las 'das par gyur pa'i phyir te/ slob spring du/ nye du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i khongs su chud gyur pa// klong gi nang du lhung ba lta bur snang bzhin du// skye shi 'phos pas ngo ma shes pa de bor nas// gal te gcig thar byed na de las khrel bor med// ces so// de dag sgrol ba'i nus pa rang la yod pa lta ci smos te/ tshangs pa brgya byin nyan rang rnams la yang med la/ 'o na su la yod na/ sangs rgyas kho na la yod pas bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thob nas sems can thams cad theg pa gsum gyi sgo nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la bzhag snyam pa dang*/

rigs can gsum ka'ang rim gyis sbyangs nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod snyam du bsam ste/ skom pa chu 'dod pa lta bu sangs rgyas la 'dod pa'i 'dun pa ma skyes kyi bar du'o// gnyis pa la/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang*/ brje ba bsgom pa dang*/ de dag gi spyod pa la bslab pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ spyod 'jug tu/ bdag dang gzhan du mnyam pa ni/ dang po nyid du 'bad de bsgom/ zhes pa ltar te tshul ji ltar na/ gang tshe bdag dang gzhan gnyis ka /bde ba 'dod du mtshungs pa la// bdag dang khyad par ci yod na// gang phyir bdag cig bde bar brtson// gang tshe bdag dang gzhan gnyis ka /duḥkha mi 'dod mtshungs pa la// bdag dang khyad par ci yod na// gang phyir gzhan min bdag srung byed// ces pa ltar bsam ste/ sems can bdag gi ma yin pas de'i 'dod pa ci yod bdag gis bsgrub dgos par 'dug pa la sems can rnams bdag dang mtshungs par bde bar 'dod duḥkha mi 'dod par 'dug pas/ da phyin rang nyid la ji ltar sgrub pa ltar sems can gyi duḥkha thams cad bdag gis spang bde ba thams cad bdag gis sgrub snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsams la/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /ces (356)brjod cing blo bcos ma ma yin pa skyes skyes su bsgom mo// gnyis pa ni/ spyod 'jug tu/ gang zhig bdag dang gzhan rnams ni// myur tu bskyab par 'dod pa des// bdag dang gzhan du brje bya ni// gsang ba'i dam pa spyad par bya// zhes pa ltar te tshul ji ltar na/ bdag nyid gzhan la btang bya dang*// gzhan rnams bdag bzhin bzung bar bya// zhes pa ltar te/ bdag la gces 'dzin 'dod pa'i don du sems can mdun du dmigs nas bdag bzhin du gces par bzung zhing bdag la gces 'dzin gyi blo dor nas bdag gi rgyud la sems can gyi rgyud kyi duḥkha dang las ngan thams cad smin/

bdag gi lus longs spyod dge ba dang*/ bde ba thams cad sems can la ltos med du btang snyam du bsams la/ sems can kun gyi duḥkha bdag la smin par gyur cig /bdag gi bde ba dang dge ba thams cad sems can gyi rgyud la smin par gyur cig ces brgya'am stong la sogs pa bgrang zhing blo bcos ma ma yin pa skyes skyes kyi bar bsgom mo// gsum pa ni/ spyod 'jug tu/ 'di ni bde las nyams bya zhing*// bdag gi gnod dang rtag sbyar bya// zhes pa ltar bsams te/ ci ltar na bdag gi lus longs spyod dge ba thams cad sems can la rgyangs kyis btang bas sems can re res kyang yongs su rdzogs par thob ste bde zhing skyid par bsam/ sems can gyi rgyud la yod pa'i gsod gcod rdeg 'tshog tsha grang*/ bkres skom/ ngal dub la sogs pa'i mi 'dod pa thams cad bdag gi thog tu smin nas na/ 'chi/ zug rngu/ bkres skom dpag tu med pas duḥkha bar bsams te/ gtso bor gang duḥkha bar mthong ba'i sems can de nyid kyi duḥkha gyis thogs drangs pa blang ngo*// bsam pa da lta bus rjes thob tu gzhan gyi khur khur ba la sogs pa dga' ba'i spyod pa la bslab bo/// /gsum pa ni/ gsang 'dus las/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa (357)rnam spangs pa// chos bdag med pa mnyam nyid pas// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes pa ltar bsgom pa ste/ ci ltar na bdag gzhan brje ba'i yul sems can/ rje ba po bdag nyid/ brje ba'i bde sdug rnams kyis thog drangs pa'i phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems kyi snang ba yin zhing*/ de sems su'ang ma grub ste sems 'das pa 'gags ma 'ongs pa ma skyes da lta ba skad cig gnyis su mi gnas pas rang bzhin gyis stong pa yin snyam du thag bcad de/ de'i ngang du blo gnas tshad du lhod kyis klod nas 'jog pa'o// gnyis pa thun mong min pa'i rnal 'byor pas nyams skye 'gyur la nges shes skyes skyes bsgom pa ni/

gur du/ dang po sprin gyi rnam pa ste// gnyis pa du ba 'dra ba yin// gsum pa me khyer rnam pa yin// bzhi pa mar me nyer 'bar ba// lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ste// sprin med nam mkha' 'dra ba nyid// de ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu// dngos grub nye bar 'gyur ba yin// zhes dang*/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ sgom pa mi 'chor ba'i mthong snang*/ rmi lam/ nyams gsum gsum ni rnam rtog mngon du song ba ltar khams gsum kun tu snang ngo*// zhes pa ltar rnal 'byor pa rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab mo la zhugs nas nyams kyi snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig skye yang*/ bsdu na bco lngar 'du ste/ 'jug pa sel ba/ chags pa gcod pa/ byang chub chen po'i lam ste lam gsum/ lus/ sems/ rmi lam nyams te nyams gsum/ rlung log /mthong snang*/ rmi lam nyams kyi rten 'brel te rten 'brel gsum/ rnam rtog sngon song*/ khams dgu 'dus pa/ thig le 'bar zhing brtan pa'i drod de drod gsum/ mtshan nyid sna tshogs/ rang bzhin stong pa/ ngo bo zung 'jug ste ting nge 'dzin gsum ste de dag tu 'du'o// bco lnga po'ang ting nge 'dzin 'ba' (358)zhig tu 'du la/ de rnams kyang rang gi lus kyi rtsa dang*/ rtsa yi ge dang*/ khams bdud rtsi dang*/ snying po ye shes rlung gi rten 'brel sems kyis dbang byas pa la brten nas byung ba yin pas de rnams kyis mthun pa'i rkyen la dga' ba bya rgyu yang med/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs la mi dga' ba bya rgyu yang med snyam du spros pa chod par byas la yang yang bsgom/ lan cig nyams skyes pa'i tshe 'di ni lus nyams so 'di ni sems nyams so zhes pa la sogs pa ngo shes par byas la byung rgyal du bskyang ngo*// gsum pa dag pa'i snang bas dkri ba ni/ 'on te nyams snang 'di lta bu sna tshogs skyes pa lam du bsrel ba la phan yon ci yod snyam na/ de dag lam du bsrel te bsgom pas khams 'dus pa gsum gyi lam chod de grub mtha' snyogs nas sa rnams rim gyis bgrod de sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo mngon du 'gyur ro// de yang sku mi zad pa ni sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gtsug tor ltar mi mngon pa sogs dang*/

sku thams cad pa gang la ci 'dul de la de'i rnam par snang ba dang*/ gsung mi zad pa ni gsung bsam gyis mi khyab pa nye ring med pas thos pa dang*/ gsung thams cad pa gdul bya rang rang gi skad du chos ston pa dus gcig tu thams cad kyis go ba dang*/ thugs mi zad pa ni thugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa ci snyed pa mkhyen pa'o// rgyan gyi 'khor lo ni rang gzhan gnyis ka mdzes par byed pa'i mdzad pa phrin las kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad pas so// gdul bya grol bar mdzad pa ste de lta bu la sogs pa sangs rgyas la yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga'o snyam du bsgom/ de nas ngas nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu 'di lta bu 'thob pa yin snyam du 'bras bu la spro ba khyad par can skyes skyes su bsgom mo// gnyis pa rgyud gsum gyis dkri ba la/ rgyu rkyen 'khor ba'i gnas lugs/ lam bsgom pa'i tshul/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ (359)ma dag pa'i snang ba'i skabs ltar rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa zhig bstan la yid ches bskyed do// gnyis pa la/ gzhi dam tshig la gnas par bya ba/ gang zag ci ltar dkri ba'i tshul/ nges shes khyad par can bskyed la ting nge 'dzin ngo shes par bya zhing lam gyi sa mtshams rnam par gzhag pa'o// dang po ni/ lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba dang gang zag 'bring gi lam gyi gtso bo dbang dang dam tshig la gnas pa yin te de la gnas pas gang zag thams cad dkrir rung bas so// des na dam tshig nyams na dbang blang zhing yan lag gi nyes pa rnams bshags bsdams la sogs pas dag par byas nas dam tshig sor chud par byas te tshul bzhin du skyong bya yin no// gnyis pa la gsum/ lta bas spros pa bcad pa'i phyir kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das dbyer med bsgom/ lam gyi nyams bskyed pa'i phyir lus thabs rgyud bsgom/ 'bras bu sku lnga mngon du 'gyur tshul lo// dang po la lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum gyi sgo nas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba mdor bstan/

nyams su blang ba'i gnad gsum gyis rgyas par bshad/ rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas shin tu rgyas par bshad pa dang gsum gyi dang po la gnyis las/ lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum gyi sgo nas nyams su blang tshul dngos ni sgom pa gsum gyi skabs dang 'dra bar bla ma la mos gus zhag 'ga' byed du bcug la/ de'i bar du shes pa klod nas ngos 'dzin du gzhug /de nas phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems su 'dus te/ sems las ma gtogs pa'i phyi rol na chos 'ga' yang med la/ sems kyang rang gi ngo bo grub tsam nas gsal ba mi 'dor bas/ gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid do zhes ngos bzung*/ gsal ba de'ang brtags na rigs kha dog dbyibs sogs gang du yang mi rnyed de/ rang bzhin gyis stong pas gsal ba/ btsal bas ma rnyed pa la stong pa ces (360)bya la/ de lta bu'i gsal ba'i dus nyid na stong la/ stong pa'i dus nyid na gsal bas gsal stong gnyis so sor sus kyang dbyer med pa de la gnyis med zung 'jug brjod bral bcos min sems kyi ngo bo ces bya ste/ tshul de ltar blos thag bcad nas de'i ngang la ma yengs par 'jog pa'o// de'i tshe rtog pa 'phro na rgyun mi mthud par dran 'dzin gyi rtog pa gang skyes de'i ngo bo gsal stong zung 'jug tu dran par byas la mnyam par bzhag go /de las don spyi tsam ma yin par zung 'jug tu rang gi blos nyams su myong ba na lta ba la nyams su myong ba ces bya ste/ snang phyogs stong phyogs zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid gsum gang skyes ngos zin par bya'o// de nas gnyis pa lhan cig skyes pa'i chos nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi sgo nas nyams su blang ba ni de lta bu'i chos gsum po de ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams te/ rang bzhin gsal ba la bden par 'khrul pas 'dod chags dang*/ rlung nang 'jug /yi ge oṃ/ rtsa rkyang ma/ khams khu ba/ nad khrag mkhris/ gdon mo rigs/

rags pa lus skye ba/ rang bzhin stong pa la 'khrul nas mi stong par brtags pas zhe sdang*/ rlung phyir 'gro/ yi ge hūm̐/ rtsa ro ma/ khams rak+ta/ nad rlung*/ gdon pho rigs/ rags pa dag skye ba/ zung 'jug la 'khrul nas gsal stong tha dad du brtags pas gti mug dang*/ rlung gnas pa/ yi ge āḥ rtsa dbu ma/ khams khu khrag 'dres pa/ nad bad kan/ gdon klu rigs/ rags pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba skyed byed du gyur pa yin par 'dug snyam du spros pa bcad de/ de'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag /'phro na/ gsal ba/ mi stong ba/ gsal stong tha dad gang la bden par 'dzin brtags la sngar ltar 'khor ba'i chos 'di dang 'di'i rtsa bar 'dug pas thar pa don gnyer gyis 'di lta bu'i spros pa byar mi rung snyam du dran par byas la 'phro ba bsal te rtse gcig tu mtshan nyid gsum gang rung la mnyam par bzhag go /(361)gnyis pa la chos thams cad sems/ sems sgyu ma/ sgyu ma rang bzhin med par sgrub pa gsum gyi dang po la gtso bo'i dpe bzhi/ yan lag gi dpe bzhis sems su sgrub pa gnyis kyi dang po la bzhi/ gnyid kyis bslad pa'i dpes sems su sgrub pa la gsum gyi sbyor ba sgom pa gsum sngon du 'gro bas dngos gzhi la dpe dran du gzhug pa ni/ rang gi rmi lam shin tu gsal ba zhig yid yul du byas la 'di ltar bsam ste/ sngar gyi rmi lam gyi snang ba sna tshogs pa 'di dag ni rmi ba'i dus na nyin par gyi snang ba 'di 'dra bar/ bden pa ltar snang yang gnyid sad pa'i gnas skabs na rmi lam gyi don gang yang ma grub par 'dug pas phyi'i don yang min la bdag nyid kyis gsal bar myong bas gtan med kyang min pa'i phyir sems nyid 'khrul pa'i dbang gis de ltar snang ba'o zhes nges shes skyed do// de dang snang ba bsre ba ni/ rmi lam gyi snang ba de dang da ltar gyi snang ba 'di la khyad ci zhig yod nyams su ni rmi lam yang bdag gis myong la/

bden ni da ltar gyi snang ba 'di'ang mi bden te/ bden na snang tshul gcig tu snang dgos pa la/ snang ba gcig kyang rkyen gyi bye brag gis yid du 'ong mi 'ong du mar nyin zhag phrug gcig la'ang snang bas so// zhes nges shes bskyed/ de'i ngang la bzhag pa ni nges shes bskyed pa de ka'i ngang la shes pa klod nas 'jog la/ 'phro ba na 'di dang rmi lam na khyad par ci yod snyam du dran 'dzin gyis bzung la mi rtog par bzhag go /rjes la gsum gyi bsngo ba ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po de la brten nas 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces smon lam 'debs pa'o// de ma rtogs pa la snying rje ni/ chos kun rmi lam ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa dam pos bcings nas 'khor bar rang gis sdug bsngal bar byed pa 'di dag snying re rje na snyam du bsgom pa'o// dpe don rtag tu dran par bya ba ni/ (362)nyin par gnas grogs longs spyod la sogs gang dang gang snang ba tsam nyid na rmi lam gyi snang ba yin snyam du rgyun ma chad par byed pa'o// de ltar sbyor dngos rjes dgu'i sgo nas dpe dang po la nges shes skyes skyes bsgom gyi/ yun ring du 'gor yang dpe dang po la nges shes ma skyes par gnyis pa man chad kyi dmigs pa mi spo'o// sbyor dngos rjes kyi chos dgu po 'di dag 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar zhing nyams su blang ngo*// 'dir dpe'i ngo bo rnams rim pa bzhin bstan na/ gnyis pa rdzas kyis bslad pas sems su bsgrub pa ni chang gis bzi ba na gang la'ang 'jigs pa med pa'am/ dga' ba dang gdung ba'i rgyur snang ba lta bu dang*/ gsum pa nad kyis ni mig ser gyi nad kyi dbang gis snang ba ser po dang*/ bdag nyid du mar snang ba dang*/ bzhi pa gdon gyis ni/ bdag nyid 'dres mnan pa'am/ gzhan gdon gyis zin pa na med bzhin du 'jigs pa sna tshogs gsal ba lta bu'o/// /gnyis pa yan lag la bzhi las mig yor ni/

mig btsir ba na ka bum sogs kyi dngos po gcig nyid gnyis su mthong ba de/ mig gang rung cig btsum pa na med par 'gyur bas phyi rol na med cing*/ bdag nyid kyis mthong bas gtan med kyang min pa'i phyir/ rang gi sems nyid 'khrul pa'i dbang gis der snang ba'o// gnyis pa rab rib ni/ mig gi dbang po rab rib kyis zin pas nam mkha' la bltas pa'i tshe skra shad dam sbrang bu'i tshogs med bzhin du mthong ba lta bu dang*/ gsum pa mgal me ni/ shing bu phra mo'i rtse la me sbar te myur tu bskor ba na 'khor lo ltar snang yang*/ me de phyogs gcig na yod pa'i tshe phyogs gzhan na med pa lta bu'o// bzhi pa myur tu 'khor ba ni/ lag pa brkyangs te lus phyogs kun tu bskor bas sa nam mkha' dang*/ nam mkha' sar 'gro ba sogs su snang ba lta bu'o// de dag la brten nas phyi (363)rol gyi snang ba 'di phywa'am dbang phyug gam rdul phran la sogs pas byas pa min gyi/ rang gi sems kyi rnam 'phrul lo// zhes spros pa gcod pa'o// de dag kyang gur las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing gang zag med// rnam par shes pa'i gnas don nam// phyi rol gyur pa cung zad med// ces dang*/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ bag chags kyis ni dkrugs pa'i sems// don du snang ba rab tu 'byung*// don yod ma yin sems de nyid// phyi rol don mthong log pa yin// zhes dang*/ tshig rkang las/ chos rnams sems nyid snang ba ces pa'i don to// gnyis pa sems sgyu mar sgrub pa la gnyis las/ gtso bo'i dpe bzhi las sgyu ma bden nam snyam na ma yin gyis/ dper na sgyu ma'i rdzas gyo mo dang spre mjug la sogs pa la sngags kyis btab pa las/ med bzhin du rta glang dang khang khyim la sogs pa du mar snang ba bzhin du/ sems nyid sna tshogs su 'khrul pa'i bag chags kyi rgyu las/ da ltar rang gi sems nyid sna tshogs su snang bar skye'i/

bag chags med na mi skye bas don dam du grub cing rang dbang can du 'byung ba 'ga' yang med do// gnyis pa smig rgyu ni sa'i rlangs pa rlung gis btab pa thag ring po nas lung pa chus gang bar mthong ba'o// gsum pa chu zla ni/ nam mkha' sprin gyis ma bsgribs pa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shar ba dang*/ chu dwangs pa'i rkyen gsum tshogs pa na chu nang du zla ba'i gzugs brnyan snang la ma tshogs na mi snang ba'o// bzhi pa glog ni bar snang gi chu bur dang rlung gi rkyen tshogs pa na shin tu gsal ba'i 'od zer 'khyug par snang ba'o// gnyis pa yan lag gi dpe bzhi las 'phrog pa'i zla ba ni/ shar lho ha ri kel+la na mtshan mo char bab pa'i nang par sprin dengs na rgya mtsho'i nang du grong khyer gyi dngos po med bzhin du snang ba'am/ yang na rgyal po seng ge zla ba'i grong (364)khyer gyi logs shin tu dwangs par yod pa la khang khyim mi dang rta glang la sogs pa'i gzugs brnyan shar ba yin nam snyam pa'o// gnyis pa dri ba'i grong khyer ni/ yul gyi khyad par dang sprin nye ba'i rgyud las grong du snang ba'o// gsum pa sprin ni/ mkha' la sprin phung snang ba de dang po skye ba na gang nas 'ong ba dang*/ dengs pa na gang du song ba'i sa mi rnyed kyang sa'i rlangs nam mkhar chags pa'i rgyu las snang ba'o// bzhi pa 'ja' tshon ni/ nyi zer dang sprin gyi grib ma tshogs pa las kha dog sna tshogs su thag ring po nas snang la drung du phyin na gang yang mi snang ba'o// de dag gis ni sems rang la'ang bden pa'i rang bzhin med de sems nyid kyi 'gyur ba sna tshogs kyi stobs kyis rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas 'bras bu sna tshogs skye bas so zhes spros pa gcod pa ste/ brtag gnyis las/ rang bzhin gdod nas ma skyes pa// bden min rdzun min de bzhin du// thams cad chu yi zla ba ltar// 'dod pas rnal 'byor mas shes gyis// zhes dang*/

sam+bu ṭir/ dri za'i grong khyer lta bu dang*// sgyu ma smig rgyu 'dra ba dang*// 'phrog pa zla ba'i grogs mtshungs dang*// rmi lam rtse ba lta bur blta// zhes dang*/ yum las gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar sgyu ma lta bur gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis gzugs brnyan yin phyir zhes pa'i don to// gsum pa sgyu ma rang bzhin med par sgrub pa la/ snang ba rten 'brel dang*/ rten 'brel brjod bral du sgrub pa gnyis kyi dang po la// gnyis kyi gtso bo'i dpe bzhi las/ kha ton ni/ rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las byung bar bden nam snyam na ma yin te/ bla ma'i kha ton las slob ma'i kha ton byung ba'i tshe bla ma'i kha ton la ma brten par yang slob ma'i kha bton mi 'byung la/ slob mar 'phos pa la ma yin pa bzhin du brjod pa snga (365)phyi dang*/ skye 'chi dang*/ skad cig gong 'og gi gnas skabs kun tu snga ma snga ma la ma brten par phyi ma phyi ma mi 'byung bas 'gag pa med pa zhes bya la/ snga ma phyi mar 'phos pa med pas skye ba med pa ste/ des na dbus su gnas pa med pas skye 'jig 'gro 'ong mtha' dbus med pa'i phyir sgro skur gyi mtha' las grol ba'o// zhes nges shes bskyed do// gnyis pa mar me ni/ sdong bu rlan dang bral ba dang*/ 'bru mar dang*/ me'i rkyen tshogs pa las snang ba'o// gsum pa me long ni/ me long g.ya' yongs su dag pa byad bzhin gyi gzugs dang 'phrad pa las me long gi nang du gzugs brnyan 'char ba'o// bzhi pa rgya ni/ ra la sogs pa la byas pa'i rgya/ la cha'am 'jim pa la btab pas rgya'i nang gi ri mo dang 'dra ba'i gzugs brnyan 'byung ba'o// gnyis pa yan lag gi dpe la bzhi las/ me shel ni/ sgrib byed sprin dang bral ba/ me shel shin tu dwangs pa/ nyi ma'i 'od zer shin tu gsal ba gsum 'tshogs pa na spra ba rlan med pa las me myur tu skye ba'o// gnyis pa sa bon ni/ sā lu ljang pa'i mdo'i yang don te/

zhing sa gshin pa rkyen nam zla drod gsher 'dzom pa sa bon skyon med pa gsum 'tshogs pas myu gu sdong po snye ma nas kyi bar du skye ba'o// gsum pa skyur ni/ shing thog skyur po 'ga' zhig rang gis zos pa'i bag chags rgyud la yod pa pha rol pos rang gis zos pa de'i rigs can gyi shing thog skyur po za ba mthong bas sad par byas pa na bdag 'gram chu ldang zhing khar chu 'byung ba'o// bzhi pa brag cha ni/ khang pa'am brag dpang mthon po'i drung du skad gsal po gcig brjod pa las/ de dang 'dra ba'i sgra grags par 'gyur ba'o// de thams cad kyang rang rang gi rgyu la ma brten par mi 'byung bas 'gags med/ rgyu snga ma snga ma 'bras bu (366)phyi ma phyi mar 'phos pa min pas skye med do ces snga ma bdun po kun la sbyar ro// de dag ni sgyu ma zhes bya ba'i rgyu rkyen bden par grub pa gcig kyang med la/ rgyu 'bras bur 'ongs pa'ang med cing*/ rgyu la ma brten par 'bras bu 'byung ba'ang med pas 'gro 'ong skye 'gag med pa'o zhes sgrub pa'i don te/ brtag gnyis las/ 'di lta ste/ gtsubs shing dang gtsubs stan dang*/ skyes bu'i lag pa'i rtsol ba las me skye bar 'gyur ro// me 'di gtsubs shing la yang mi gnas/ gtsubs stan la yang ma yin skyes bu'i lag pa dag la yang ma yin te/ rnam pa thams cad du yongs su btsal na gcig na yang yod pa ma yin pas/ me de yang bden pa yang ma yin rdzun pa yang ma yin no// de ltar chos thams cad rnal 'byor mas yid la gyis shig ces dang*// sā lu ljang pa'i mdo las/ chu zla'i gzugs brnyan ji bzhin pa// de bzhin 'di nas 'chi 'pho ba// 'ga' med 'gro bar skye bar snang*// zhes dang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis// kha ton mar me me long rgya// me shel sa bon skyur dang sgras// phung po nying mtshams sbyor ba dag /mi 'pho bar yang mkhas rtogs bya// zhes dang*/

slob dpon gyis phyi nang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i lam gyis zhes pa'i don to// gnyis pa brjod bral du bsgrub pa la gnyis kyi rtsa ba'i dpe la bzhi'i gzhon nu'i rgod pa ni/ bu chung smra mi shes par rgod pa'i tshe/ rgod pa'i rgyu mtshan cig yod kyang de'i rang bzhin smra mi shes pa'o// gnyis pa lkugs pa'i rmi lam ni/ lkugs pa la rmi lam byung yang 'di lta bu zhes smra mi shes pa'o// gsum pa gnad la phrugs pa ni mchan khung la sogs pa g.ya'i gnas 'ga' zhig tu gzhan gyis phrugs pa na g.ya' ba de nyams su myong yang 'di'o zhes smra mi shes pa'o// bzhi pa dbang po'i bde ba ni/ 'khrig pa'i bde ba myong yang (367)smra mi shes pa'o// gnyis pa yan lag gi dpe la bzhi'i gsum pa'i ye shes ni/ dbang gsum pa'i dus su myong ba'i ye shes so// gnyis pa gsang ba'i snyoms 'jug ni/ 'og dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i skabs su 'chad pa ltar lag pa'i phyag rgya la brten pa'i ye shes so// gsum pa longs spyod kyi rlabs ni/ mgrin pa nas rtsa gsum rgyu ba'i thig le dang khrag rgyu ba'i srang bor nas rlung rgyu ba'i srang mnan pa las skyes pa'i ye shes so// bzhi pa dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ni/ 'og ltar dngos sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten nas skyes pa'i ye shes te/ de dag nyams su myong yang 'di'o zhes brjod par mi nus pa bzhin du/ chos thams cad zung 'jug gam rang bzhin med bzhin du rgyu rkyen 'tshogs pa'i rten 'brel las byung bar nges shes skyes kyang 'di'o zhes brjod mi shes pas brjod bral du 'dug snyam du nges shes bskyed la mnyam par bzhag go /de dag kyang brtag gnyis las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// ces dang*/ mdo bden gnyis bstan par/ lha'i bu don dam pa'i bden pa ni tha snyad thams cad las shin tu 'das pa ste/

bye brag med pa/ ma skyes pa ma 'gags pa brjod par bya ba dang rjod par byed pa dang*/ shes pa dang shes bya dang bral ba'o zhes dang*/ tog tse bas/ gnyis su med pa ming tsam ste// de la ming ni yod ma yin// gnyis med ming du bzung ba la// bdag la rnal 'byor pas bzod mdzod// ces dang*/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ de kho na nyid mtsho'i don dang ma bral ba zhes so// de dag gis ni tshul bzhi/ dpe sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis gtan la phab nas/ yang gsal bar 'dod pas dpe'i gtso bo bzhi btus la/ de re re'ang chos bzhi bzhis gtan la phab pa'i tshul gyis (368)nyams su blang na/ sems su bsgrub pa'i dpe'i nang nas rmi lam gyi dpes chos bzhi gtan la dbab pa ni/ rmi lam gang gsal ba cig dran du bcug la/ de nyid ni sems las ma gtogs pa phyi rol tu grub pa med pas sems/ de nyin mo'i rtog pa sna tshogs kyi rgyu las byung bas sgyu ma rmi lam dang*/ gnyid sad pa'i gnas skabs su snga ma la ma brten par phyi ma mi 'byung la/ snga ma phyi mar ma 'phos pas 'gro 'ong med pa'i phyir rten 'brel/ de dag 'gal ba ltar myong zhing myong yang 'di lta bu zhes brjod du mi btub pas brjod bral lo// de bzhin du sgyu ma'i dpe'i nang nas chu zla dang*/ rten 'brel gyi dpe'i nang nas sa bon dang*/ brjod bral gyi dpe'i nang nas gnad la phrugs pa'i bde ba dran du bcug la/ de re re'ang*/ sems/ sgyu ma/ rten 'brel/ brjod bral du gtan la phab la nges shes skyed de/ de dang snang ba bsre ba sogs sngar bzhin sbyar zhing nyams su blang ngo*// dpe'i gtso bo gcig tu btus pa la'ang nges shes bskyed pa ni/ longs spyod kyi rlabs la brten nas lhan skyes kyi ye shes bskyed la de nyid sems sogs bzhir gtan la phab pa la sogs pa sngar ltar nyams su blang ngo*// de ltar snang ba sems su bsgoms pas phyi rol tu zhen pa'i blo ldog

/sems sgyu mar bsgom pas sems su bden 'dzin gyi blo ldog /sgyu ma rten 'brel du bsgoms pas 'gro 'ong rtag chad du 'dzin pa'i blo ldog /rten 'brel brjod bral du bsgoms pas sems nyid kyang nam mkha' ltar mtha' dang bral bar khong du chud do// gsum pa rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa la kun gzhi rgyu rgyud// lus thabs rgyud/ phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud kyi khrid do// dang po ni/ de ltar brten ngal bzhi la me tog dang me tog gi dri'i tshul gyis brten pa'i sems kun gzhi 'di nyid la 'khor 'das rgyu lam 'bras bus bsdus pa'i chos thams cad bag chags (369)sam sa bon gyi tshul du tshang la/ de'ang*/ sad byed kyi rkyen dang 'phrad pas mtshan nyid sna tshogs su snang yang*/ snang ba ltar bden par ma grub pas rang bzhin stong pa/ stong bzhin du snang*/ snang bzhin du stong pas rang bzhin zung du 'jug pa'o zhes nges shes bskyed de'i ngang la rtse gcig tu bzhag go /de dag kyang brtag gnyis su/ 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste// 'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa nyid// ces dang*/ klu sgrub kyis/ 'khor ba spangs bar gyur pa yi// mya ngan 'das khyed mi bzhed kyis// 'khor ba mi dmigs pa nyid ni// zhi nyid mgon po khyod kyis bstan// zhes dang*/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das tshang*/ zhes so// gnyis pa la/ dbang*/ lam/ nyams la nges shes bskyed pa'o// dang po la gsum las/ dal la 'khor 'das bsre ba ni/ bum dbang rgya che ba'i dbang du byas na/ sangs rgyas kyis phung po lnga/ rig mas 'byung ba lnga/ byang sems kyis nang gi skye mched/ lha mos phyi'i skye mched/ khro bo khro mos tshigs chen brgyad// spyi bo dang rkang gnyis te bcu sbyong la/ de dag kyang sbyang gzhi 'khor ba/ sbyong byed mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ sbyang gzhi rnams sbyong byed de dang de'i ngo bor gsal btab nas bsgoms pas 'khor 'das dbyer med do// mchog dbang zab pa'i dbang du byas na yi ge bha ga'i dal la/

snying ga'i bu āṃ dz+rīṃ khāṃ hūm̐ sangs rgyas kyi/ lāṃ māṃ āṃ tāṃ yum bzhi'i/ pu dza la sogs pa'i yi ge yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang*/ ā li kā li lnga bcu byang sems lha mo/ tshig brgyad rkang mthil spyi bo rnams na hūm̐ bcu gnas pa khro bo khro mo'o// byang chub sems kyi dal la bdud rtsi lnga'i dwang ma sangs rgyas/ 'byung bzhi bde ba nam mkha'i rang bzhin dang bcas pa lnga rig ma/ mig sogs dbang po rnams dang so dang sen mo sogs yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dwangs ma byang chub sems dpa'i/ bdag gi lus kyi yul gzugs sogs rnams kyi dwangs (370)ma lha mo// lus kyi yan lag dang nying lag thams cad kyi dwangs ma khro bo khro mo'o// snying po ye shes rlung gi dbang du byas na/ gzhi rtsa ba'i rlung lnga re re gtso bor gyur pa dgu brgya pa phrag re re sangs rgyas/ de re re la sogs 'byung bzhis phye ba nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga pa re re mnyam par gyur pa rig ma de nyid mig sogs nas rgyu ba dang*/ yan lag gi rlung dgu brgya pa phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi po byang sems dang lha mo/ yan lag gi rlung khyab byed pags pa dang ba spu'i tshogs la gnas pa khro bo khro mo'o// gnyis pa dbang la 'khor 'das bsre ba ni/ bum dbang gi dbang du byas na dbang rdzas bum pa la sogs pa dang*/ bskur bya slob ma'ang rigs lnga yab yum du bskyed/ skye mched byin gyis brlabs pa la sogs pa bya ste/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i lhas dbang bskur bas 'byung lnga phung lnga nyon mongs lnga yum lnga sangs rgyas lnga ye shes lngar byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ gsang dbang la yang gdan gsum tshang ba'i bla mas bsgrubs pa'i thig la byang chub kyi sems kyis gdan gsum tshang ba'i slob ma la dbang bskur ba na phung po dang bdud rtsi lnga'i dwangs ma sangs rgyas/ skye mched kyi dwangs ma byang sems/ 'byung ba'i dwangs ma lha mo// tshigs spyi bo rkang mthil bcu'i dwangs ma khro bo khro mo'i gdan no// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la yang slob ma'i lus bha ga byang sems la gdan gsum tshang ba de la phyag rgya gdan gsum tshang ba gtad de/

'du shes gsum gyis snyoms par zhugs pas rten kun rdzob kyi byang sems gdan gsum tshang ba de dbab bzung ldog khyab mi nyams par bzung ba'i tshul gyis bskur ba'o// bzhi pa'i dbang la'ang slob dpon gdan gsum tshang bas slob ma gdan gsum tshang ba la bzhi pa lnga gang rung bskur ba'i sgo nas 'khor 'das dbyer med du ngo sprod pa byed pa'o// de dag kyang sbyang gzhi 'khor ba sbyang byed mya ngan las 'das pa/ de gnyis ro gcig rtogs pa 'khor 'das dbyer med do// (371)gsum pa dbang gi ye shes la 'khor 'das bsre ba ni/ bum dbang las skyes pa'i ye shes yul snang stong zung 'jug /gsang dbang las skyes pa'i ye shes gsal stong zung 'jug /dbang gsum pa las skyes pa'i ye shes lus bde stong zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin/ dbang bzhi pa las skyes pa'i lta ba shin tu rnam dag bde stong mchog gi ting nge 'dzin te/ de dag sbyang gzhi phung po dang*/ 'byung ba lnga sbyong ba dang*/ de dag gi dwangs ma dang rlung bcu zin pa las skyes pa'i cha nas sangs rgyas dang rig ma/ skye mched dang yul drug sbyong zhing de dag gi dwangs ma dang yan lag gi rlung dgu brgya pa phrag nyi shu po zin pa las skyes pa'i cha nas byang sems dang lha mo/ tshigs spyi bo rkang mthil gyi dwangs ma dang*/ khyab byed kyi rlung pags pa dang ba spu la gnas pa zin pa'i cha nas khro bo dang khro mo'i gdan yin la/ de ltar gdan gsum tshang ba'i ye shes de rnams kyi'ang/ snang ba/ gsal ba/ dga' ba dang po gsum 'khor ba/ stong pa dang lhan skyes myang 'das/ de dag shes pa gcig gi ngo bor ro gcig pa dbyer med do// de dag kyang gsang 'dus las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas lnga ni rab tu bshad// rdo rje skye mched nyid dag ni// byang chub sems dpa'i da la mchog /sa ni spyan zhes bya ba ste// chu yi khams ni ma mā ki /dkar dang sgrol ma zhes bya ba// me dang rlung du rab tu grags// zhes dang*/

rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ gdan sogs gsum pa bzhis rgyu'i dbang bstan zhes so// gnyis pa lam la nges shes bskyed pa la gsum las/ bskyed rim la 'khor 'das bsres la nges shes bskyed pa ni/ sngon 'gro tshogs bsags pa la sbyang bya snga ma'i las/ sbyong byed tshogs gnyis ni 'khor 'das kyi rgyu/ de gnyis kyi sgrub pa po'i sems rgyud gcig gis bsdus pas dbyer med/ chos 'byung gis rnam thar sgo gsum mtshon la/ rnam thar las 'khor 'das gnyis ka byung ba dang*/ gzhal yas (372)khang gis snod sbyong la/ gnyis ka'ang 'byung bzhi las byung zhing 'khor 'das kyi snang ba yin la/ de gnyis ro gcig tu rnal 'byor pas bsgoms pas dbyer med do// bskyed chog la yang mngon byang lnga las drod gsher skyes thig le las bzhengs pas sgong skyes/ mngal nas 'byin pas mngal skyes/ snying po tshig tsam las skyes pas brdzus skyes sbyong ba/ lha'i sku mdog phyag mtshan la yang*/ dag bya nyon mongs lnga/ dag byed ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin/ sangs rgyas lnga'i sku mdog phyag mtshan du bsgoms pas dag par byed la/ phyag zhabs la yang g.yas g.yon 'khor 'das/ phyed krung dang skyil krung sogs su bzhugs pa zung 'jug /mnyam bzhag myang 'das/ thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor 'khor ba dang chos mthun la/ de dag sgrub pa po gcig gi rgyud la yang dbyer mi phyed pas 'khor 'das dbyer med do// gnyis pa rang byin rlabs la/ 'khor 'das bsres la nges shes bskyed pa ni/ rlung nang du 'jug pa yi ge oṃ/ sbyang bya 'dod chags/ nyams gsal ba'i cha/ 'bras bu sprul sku/ rlung gnas pa yi ge āḥ dag bya gti mug /nyams zung 'jug /'bras bu longs sku/ rlung phyir 'gro yi ge hūm̐/ dag bya zhe sdang*/ nyams stong cha/ 'bras bu chos sku ste/ de dag ro gcig par rtogs pa 'khor 'das dbyer med do// gsum pa dal 'khor lo la 'khor 'das bsres la nges shes bskyed pa ni/

bdag dang phyag rgya'i phung po lnga nyon mongs lnga/ skye mched yul rnam rtog sogs 'khor ba/ 'du shes gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ snyoms par zhugs nas dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes skye ba myang 'das/ de gnyis sgrub pa po gcig gi rgyud la dbyer mi phyed par nyams su len pas dbyer med do// bzhi pa rba rlabs gyi lam la 'khor 'das bsres la nges shes bskyed pa ni/ (373)bdag dang phyag rgya pad+ma can gyi rten dal bzhi 'khor ba/ brten pa bde stong mchog gi ye shes myang 'das/ zung du 'jug pas dbyer med do// gsum pa nyams la nges shes bskyed pa'i thabs gsum las/ ma dag pa'i nyams kyi snang ba la brten nas las rgyu 'bras la nges shes khyad par can bskyed pa ni/ bdag rgyud la rten dal bzhi'i rten 'brel gyis 'khor ba khams gsum rigs drug skye gnas bzhi snod bcud gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i nyams du ma skyes pa'i tshe da ltar bdag gi lus 'di las rnam shes ma 'phos bzhin du rigs drug gi nyams snang sna tshogs 'di lta bu 'char na/ shi nas las kyi dbang gis rigs drug so so'i lus blangs nas rigs drug gi nyams sna tshogs ci ltar mi 'char te 'char nges la/ de thams cad dung las kyis bslad pa'i rang gi sems kyi snang ba yin te/ bdag 'dug sa gcig na 'dug bzhin du rigs drug gi snang ba tha dad du 'byung ba'i phyir snyam du nges shes bskyed do// de la brten nas las rgyu 'bras la yid ches shing log lta spang bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa lam gyi nyams la brten nas lam thams cad theg pa gcig tu sgrub pa ni/ dal bzhi'i 'du 'phrod la rten nas rtag chad du blta ba dang*/ bem po'i bdag tu blta ba dang*/ tshangs pa dbang phyug sogs 'jig rten gyi byed pa por 'dzin pa dang*/ rdul phran dang 'byung ba rgyur gyur dang*/ brjod du med pa'i bdag dang*/ bye brag tu smra ba dang*/ mdo sde pa/

sems tsam pa'i lta ba la sogs pa nyams kyi snang ba du ma skyes pa'i tshe 'di thams cad dal bzhi'i rgyud tshul la brten nas rang gi nyams la skyes pa tsam yin pas 'khrul pa'i snang ba yin gyi yang dag par na bden par ma grub pas theg pa tha dad pa cung zad kyang med snyam du nges shes bskyed cing bsgom mo// de la brten nas theg pa gcig tu rtogs par 'gyur (374)ro// gsum pa yig 'bru'i nyams kyi snang ba la brten nas sangs rgyas la mos gus dang spro ba khyad par can bskyed pa ni/ snying po'i ar rlung sems 'dus pas chos sku dang*/ snying ga'i rigs lnga'i yi ger rlung sems 'dus pas longs sprul gyi nyams skyes te 'di nyid sku gsum gyi rang bzhin no zhes 'du shes pa'i tshe 'di sangs rgyas dngos min gyi nyams snang yin la/ sangs rgyas pa na 'di bas kyang mchog tu gyur pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab pa'i 'byung gnas su 'dug snyam pa'i mos gus dang*/ bdag gis kyang de thob na ci ma rung snyam pa'i spro ba yang yang du bskyed do// gsum pa gnas gyur lhun grub mi 'gal ba'i sgo nas 'bras bu 'khor 'das dbyer med la nges shes bsgom pa ni rgyu rten dal bzhi la rang bzhin gyis sku bzhi'i sa bon gnas pa ni/ mngon du gyur pa na sku bzhir lhun gyis grub pas 'bras bu lhun grub ste/ rgyu de 'khor ba'i chos nyid dang tshul mtshungs pas 'khor ba/ rang bzhin de ltar yin bzhin du sku bzhi'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mngon du 'gyur ba ni/ gnas brten dal bzhi lam gyis sku bzhir sgyur ba'i yon tan yin pas gnas gyur mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ste/ chos nyid la ltos nas lhun grub/ yon tan la ltos nas gnas gyur yin pas mi 'gal zhing 'bras bu yang chos nyid dang gnas gyur gyi sgo nas dbyer med du nges shes bskyed do// de la nges shes skyes na thos bsam gyi lta ba mthar phyin cing*/

sgom byung gi ye shes cung zad skyes pa zhes bya ba yin no// kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi khrid bstan zin to// gnyis pa lam gyi nges shes bskyed pa'i phyir lus thabs rgyud bsgom pa la/ bum/ gsang*/ shes rab ye shes/ bzhi pa'i dbang gi lam bsgom pa'o// dang po la bskyed rim gyi bya ba dang*/ de la sems bzung ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i sngon du/ bla ma las lam dus kyi dbang blang ste dam tshig gso/ bla ma mi bzhugs na bdag nyid kyis sgrub pa'i dal bris la bdag 'jug (375)rgyas par bya/ mi mthun pa'i rkyen spangs nas mthun pa'i chas 'grigs pa'i tshe sgrub pa la 'jug ste/ de'ang phyi nang gi bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgoms nas bsnyen pa bzhi 'bum la sogs pa ci 'grub bzla/ de'i bcu cha zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ phyi nang gi bskyed rim tha mal rnam rtog gis bar ma chod par gsal zhi drag la yun thung bar bsgom pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthar// gnad la dbab pa gsum sngon du song bas lha thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal btab/ khyad par du spyan dbu ma gsal btab ste/ de la sems rtse gcig tu bzung*/ gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad la dngos po gzhan zhig la sems yongs su gzhug /yang gsal btab la bsgom/ mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro bcad/ cung zhig rtsol ba klod/ yang bsgom/ des kyang mi gsal na bris pa'i spyan dbu ma la blta zhing gsal btab/ des kyang gsal bar ma gyur na rang gi dpral ba'i dbus su spyan dbu ma bris nas mdun gyi nye ring dang mtho dman ran par me long shin tu gsal ba cig bzhag nas blta/ yang mig btsum zhing bsgom/ yang blta/ yang bsgom/ de lta bu yang yang byas pas dmigs pa gsal bar 'gyur ro// de ltar bsgom pas gang la gsal bar 'dod pa de la gsal ba byung na lha so so'i dag pa so ru slebs pa yin/

gsal 'phro la med par 'dod na med par bya bar nus na de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa so ru sleb/ de dag la brten nas zhi gnas kyi nyams khyad par can skyes pa ni rang rig pa'i dag pa so ru sleb pa'o// tshul de lta bus lam sbyang*/ de la brten nas skyes pa'i lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum bskyang ste/ spyan la sogs pa yul gyi steng du sems zin na snang phyogs/ dmigs pa ci yang mi snang bar stong nyams 'ba' zhig skye na stong phyogs/ du sogs kyi rtags la sems zin na zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid do// de las (376)skyes pa'i rjes thob kyi ngo bo nyid nyams su len tshul/ ma skyes na bskyang tshul rnams gzhung ci lta ba bzhin du nyams su blang ngo*// de nas spyan gsum ka la dmigs pa gtad la snga ma bzhin bsgom/ de nas dbu ril po/ de nas sku ril po/ de nas gdan de nas dal gyi lha rnams dang*/ gzhal yas khang srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa snga ma bzhin du bsgom zhing*/ spyan dbu ma'i ting nge 'dzin goms pa bzhin du goms par ma gyur gyi bar du bslab par bya'o// de ltar bdag bskyed kyi lha la dmigs pa gsal ba dang phyi rol gyi dngos po gang yang rung ba zhig rang gis lhar bsgom ste mnyam par bzhag go /de la goms pa dang rim gyis rgya bskyed cing rang gis mthong tshad kyi snang ba rnams lhar bsgom zhing goms par bya'o// de nas rang gis bsgoms pa'i lha dang dal gyi tshad kyang rgya bskyed cing mthar 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par bsgom par bya'o// de nas lha dang dal tshad je chung je chung bsdus nas yungs 'bru'i tshad tsam gyi nang du lha'i dal rdzogs par bsgom zhing gdab/ dmigs pa'i rim pa de rnams kyang spyan dbu ma'i dmigs pa ltar goms kyi bar du bsgom/ de rnams la goms pa dang yungs 'bru'i tshad tsam gyi lha dang dal gyis 'jig rten gyi khams rgya chen po khyab par bsgoms kyang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya chung ngu mi 'gro zhing lha'i sku cher mi 'gro bar bsgom zhing goms par bya'o// lha'i rnam pa de thams cad kyang snang la rang bzhin med pa'i ngo bo zung 'jug tu bsgom mo// gnyis pa gsang dbang gi lam la/

khyab byed man ngag gi gnad do// dang po la gnyis las/ khyab bya man ngag gi gnad do// bsam gtan gyi sngon 'gro ni/ grub na bla ma las dbang blang*/ ma grub na bdag 'jug bya/ de'ang ma grub na maṇ+ḍal dang yig brgya la brten nas mthun pa'i (377)pa'i rkyen tshogs bsags pa dang*/ 'gal ba'i rkyen sgrib pa sbyangs la/ lus sbyong rgyas pa phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis sam bsdus pa yan lag lnga sbyong ci 'grub byas pas lus sbyong 'byongs 'byongs sbyangs te/ re zhig 'byongs pa'i tshad ni dka' las mi 'byung zhing na tsha med la lus bde zhing yangs pa yin no// kha cig la skabs der ting nge 'dzin shugs kyis skye ba yang srid la/ gang ltar yang lus sbyong yun ring du byas na ting nge 'dzin yun ring du skye zhing bar chad mi 'byung ba yin no// de nas sbyang ba gzhan gnyis dang gnad dbab gsum sgom pa gsum kyang snga ma bzhin bya'o// gnyis pa bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la/ dmigs pa'i lugs mang na yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 'di ni khams 'dus pa dang po gtum mo rlung drod rtags kyis lam khrid pa yin pas rlung gi rnal 'byor gtso bor bzhed la/ de'i man ngag yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ bsdu na rlung ldang 'jug gnas par 'du la/ de lam du byed pa la srog rtsol lam rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ phyir btang ba'i man ngag gsum/ nang du dgang ba'i man ngag gnyis/ gnas pa lam du byed pa kha sbyor te bdun gyi dang po la bzhi las/ nyams su blang ba'i thabs ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du song nas 'khor gcig gnyis sna g.yas bkag nas g.yon rgyur gzhug /de nas gong ltar bde bar rgyur gzhug ste/ de'ang skyon can phyir 'don pa dang 'dra bas thog mar rtsol ba nas mgo 'dzin te yid sna rtse g.yas par gtad la rlung phyir rgyu ba'i dus su phyir rgyus/ nang du 'jug pa'i tshe nang du rgyus/
