cung zad gnas pa'i tshe gnas zhes dran par bya/ de nyid la sems rtse gcig tu zin nas rtog pa gzhan mi rgyu na 'jug pa sel ba'i lam/ dmigs (378)med kyi ngang du rtse gcig tu gnas na chags pa gcod pa'i lam/ du sogs kyi rtags la sems zin na byang chub chen po'i lam zhes bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin de dag gang rung skyes nas bogs dbyung ba'i phyir rtsol ba la rngan dgas rim gyis byin te// phyir 'gro je ring*/ 'jug gnas su thung ngu bya zhing sems kyis phyir ring du rgyus/ nang du thung ngu rgyus/ nang du gnas zhes dran par byas pas phyir je ring 'gro/ de'i tshe g.yon nas mi rgyu nas g.yas nas rgyu na sna g.yas ras bal la sogs pas bkag la g.yon nas rgyu ba la bslab/ bkag kyang ma 'gyur na g.yon nas rgyu bar bsams la bslab bo// de la ting nge 'dzin skyes pa dang go bzlog pa'i gnad yin pas srog nas mgo bzung ste nang du rgyus/ gnas/ phyir rgyus snyam du dran/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa byed na nang du rgyu bar oṃ/ gnas pa āḥ phyir 'gro ba hūm̐ zhes dran par byas kyang gtub bo// de la ting nge 'dzin skyes pa na de brtan pa'i yan lag tu srog la rngan dgas rim gyis byin te/ nang du 'jug je ring*/ phyir 'gro je thung btang la de dang mthun par yid kyis kyang nang du ring du rgyus/ nang du gnas/ phyir thung ngu rgyus zhes dran par byas te/ 'di nang du yun ring du gnas shing ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye'o// rjes la rlung sems kyi rtsol ba klod la lta khrid kyi skabs ltar chos gsum gyis lha ba bskyangs pas nyams mchog tu gyur pa skye'o// gnyis pa srog rtsol mthar phyin pa'i tshad la gnyis las/ rgyu ba gsal ba zhes bya ba ni rlung lnga sna bug gang nas rgyu yang g.yas g.yon steng 'og gi sbugs la 'khris nas rgyu ba la sogs pa 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung 'byung ba'i gnas dang*/

kha dog dbyibs dang ring thung gi tshad mig gis mthong ba yin no// rnam pa nges pa zhes bya ba rlung g.yas g.yon spo ba dang*/ dbang po gzhan gyi sgo nas (379)gtong ba dang bzlog par nus pa yin no// bsgom pa'i yon tan ni/ phrin las bzhi 'grub pa ste/ de'ang sa rlung rgyu ba gsal ba'i dus su sngags tsam mam bsam pa'am/ smon lam btab pa tsam gyis rgyas pa'i las 'grub/ de bzhin du chu rlung gis zhi ba/ me rlung gis dbang*/ rlung gi rlung gis mngon spyod kyi las rnams 'grub pa yin no// yang pha rol gyi srog gi rlung gi lam nas bcug nas pha rol gyi nang du kun tu bltas na pha rol kyi sems shes pa'i mngon shes kyang 'byung ngo*// skyon gang sel na/ g.yang sa dang rdib ri dang thog la sogs pa glo bur gyis 'chi ba'i rkyen gang gis kyang bar chad mi 'byung ste/ tshe la cung zad dbang ba yin no// 'di yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi yin pas rtags ma byung gi bar du bsgom pa gal che'o// de nas rlung brtan zhing bogs dbyung ba'i phyir btang ba'i yan lag gsum las/ dang po rtsol ba bkag ste srog nas btang ba'i man ngag la bzhi las nyams su blang ba'i thabs ni/ lus tsog pur gtan la dbab pa'i bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du song bar byas nas/ mgo cung zad bstod pa/ sems sna rtse'am sna bug g.yon du gtad la/ sdigs mdzub g.yas kyi gung mdzub brtsegs pas sna bug g.yas pa bkag la rlung nang du rngub ste/ g.yon nas phar gus la gtong ngo*// phyir ma rdzogs par nang du mi rngub pa dang phyir lhag ma med par sangs btang ba dang*/ rjes la dmigs pa dang rtsol ba med par dal bus 'ong du gzhug pa gsum man ngag yin zhing btang ba'i yan lag la rlung nang du 'ong du mi gzhug pa gnad du che'o// 'di ni skyon can phyir bton pa yin pas mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin shugs la skye'o// thun 'jog khar cir yang mi rtog pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag go

/mthar phyin pa'i tshad ni phyir btang (380)rgyu med pas na ci tsam 'dod par phyir bzhag nas nang du 'ong du mi gzhug par khegs pa yin no// yon tan lus bde bas khengs pa dang*/ mi rtog pa myur tu skye'o// skyon ni ro stod gzer ba dang*/ snying mi bde ba sel lo// 'di lam bsgom pa'i tshe yang nyam nga ba'i gnas su 'gro ba'am/ chu las brgal ba'i tshe rtsol ba bkag ste srog nas btang ba 'khor bdun bdun tsam byas na bar chad nges par sel lo// gnyis pa shugs bskyed de gnyis ka nas btang ba la bzhi las/ nyams su blang ba'i thabs ni sngar ltar bsam gtan gyi yan lag tshang bar byas la/ rang gi shes pa mdzod spur gtad/ rlung gi gnad gnyis ka nas shugs bskyed de drag tu bus la btang*/ phyir thub tshad gcig bzhag /btang ba la 'ong du mi gzhug pa gnad du che/ nang du 'jug pa'i tshe dmigs pa dang rtsol ba med par 'ong du gzhug /yang snga ma ltar btang*/ rlung gi gnad snga ma dang 'dra/ de la zhag gsum tsam bsgom/ de nas rang gi mdun khru gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la yid gtad/ de nas 'dom gang tsam/ de nas mdung gang tsam/ de nas rgya che ba'i lung pa tsam/ de nas sa skor cig tsam/ de nas gling bzhi de nas stong gsum/ mthar 'jig rten gyi khams kyi nam mkha' thams cad la yid gtad pa'am/ yang na shis pa ci yang mi rtog pa la gtad la bsgom/ rjes lta ba gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin ngos bzung la mnyam par bzhag go /mthar phyin pa'i tshad 'dra/ yon tan gsal ba'i nyams su myong ba mthar thug pa skye/ skyon mgo na ba dang mig khrag tu 'ong ba la sogs pa thams cad sel bar nus so// gsum pa kha nas sgra bcas su btang ba ni/ sngar ltar bsam gtan gyi yan lag rnams tshang bar byas la so bsgrigs nas/ sems kyi gnad rang gi 'dom gang tsam gyi 'khor yug gi nam mkha' la sems (381)gtad pa'am/ si'i sgra la sems gtad la/ rlung gi gnad so bar na si'i sgra dang bcas pas bus la btang*/

phyir thub tshad mnan/ btang ba la nang du 'ong du mi gzhug pa gnad du che/ nang du 'jug pa na dmigs pa med par rim gyis 'od du gzhug ste/ khrag mkhris shas che na sgra bcas/ grang rlung shas chen sgra med du drang*/ mthar phyin pa'i tshad snga ma dang 'dra/ yon tan lus ldang ba yang ba dang zo bdog bde ba 'byung ngo*// skyon khrag ro dang rims glo bur ba la sogs pa tshad nad mtha' dag sel bar nus so// de gsum la bogs dbyung ba ni thabs 'gal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ dpung pa gyen du re mos kyis btegs/ steng rlung shugs bskyed de btang la 'og rlung drag tu drangs la rgyu zhabs drag tu bskum/ de la bogs dbyung ba ni spyod lam des spyi bo nas rlung spos kyi dud pa lta bu byung*/ gshang lam nas thon/ 'og gi khru gang gang tsam du 'khyil ba la shes pa gtad/ steng rlung thub tshad mnan/ 'og rlung cung zad bskum/ de'i tshe'ang gsus pa phyir 'phel du mi gzhug go /gsum pa nang du dgang ba'i man ngag gnyis kyi dang po rtsol ba bkag ste srog nas dgang ba ni/ lus gnad skyil krung du gtan la phab pa'i bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu tshang bar byas la lte bar sgo nga'i lkog pa 'dra ba phyi dkar la nang ser ba cig gi nang na mar la rlung sib sib 'gro bar bsam/ mgo cung zad mdun du sgu bar bya ste g.yas kyi gung mdzub brtsegs pas sna g.yas pa bkag la g.yon nas rim gyis rlung rngubs nas rdzogs pa dang mgo g.yas bskor du lan cig bskor zhing gsig /rlung gi rta mchil ma sgra med par mid la rlung thub tshad du bsnan/ lan cig la rlung rdzogs par rngub kyi yang yang mi rngub pa dang*/ mi thub pa'i tshe sems dmigs pa med par dal bus phyir gtong ba gnad du che'o// mthar phyin (382)pa'i tshad ci tsam 'dod tshang thub cing na tsha med pa yin/ yon tan drod dang bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye ste/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi nyams kyang 'di la skyes pa yin gsung ngo*// skyon grang ba dang*/

skran dang*/ ma zhu ba'i nad rnams sel lo// gnyis pa kha nas sgra med du dgang ba la/ nyams su blang tshul ni/ sngar ltar bsam gtan gyi yan lag rnams tshang bar byas nas/ lte bar chos 'byung gru gsum sngon po'i nang na mar rlung thams cad sib sib 'gro bar bsam zhing kha phye la rlung kha nas sgra med du dal bus ring bar rngub/ rdzogs pa dang mchil ma sgra med du mid la mgo gsig /nor bu lkog mas mnan la thub tshad du bzung*/ gtong dus dmigs pa med par dal bus btang*/ rjes lta ba bskyang*/ mthar phyin pa'i tshad nyin mtshan med par mnan yang na tsha med par thub pa yin/ yon tan drod dang bsdongs nas bde gsal skye/ skyon dmu chu la sogs pa'i lte ba'i nad sel ba/ khyad par du gang na sar rlung mnan la 'bigs pa lta bu byas na 'byung ba lus 'khrugs thams cad sel lo// de gnyis kyi thun mong du gnyis ka'i dmigs pa snga ma'i mjug thog tu bsgom bya'i dmigs pa ni lte bar 'od dkar po gcig gi nang na a dmar po mtshal gyi shad lta bu zhig la rlung sib sib 'gro bar dmigs pa'am/ 'od dkar po med par dmar po nyid la sib sib song bas me sor gnyis sam bzhi'i bar la dmigs pa'am/ lte bar chos 'byung dmar po'am ser po dmigs la de sa gzhi ltar rgya bskyed de rlung mnan pas chos 'byung de rgya je che la song mthar sa gzhi thams cad khyab/ de'i nang stong par song ba'i nang du rlung 'jug pa dang*/ yang rgya mtsho ltar gting zab par bsgoms te tshul yang rlung mnan pas gshang lam gyi nang du chos 'byung gi zhabs zangs dung gi kha (383)ltar dmar sang nge ba gting mi mngon pa'i nang du rlung thams cad song bar bsams la rlung bzung*/ yang nam mkha' ltar dbang bstod de tshul yang rlung thams cad 'jug pa'i dmigs pa byas pas sems dang nam mkha' 'dres nas ro gcig tu gyur te stong nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin mtha' dbus med pa mchog tu gyur pa skye'o// skabs su byi la'i spyod pa bya'o// de gnyis la bogs dbyung ba ni/

skyil krung bcas te lag pa gnyis kyis rkang pa'i bsnol mtshams nas bzung ste/ sgul zhing 'og rlung mi bsdam par steng rlung drangs la mnan/ smad kyi gsus pa btub tshad kyis phyir phul la bsgom/ gnyer ma med pa dang*/ ma zhu ba sel ba 'grub/ de la bogs dbyung ba ni/ sngar ltar byas la gsang gnas kyi rtsa ru 'dom nas rlung spos kyi dud pa lta bu bun gyis byung nas yang yang song nas spyi gtsug nas 'thon nas khru gang tsam du sngo rgyang nge 'phur ba la shes pa gtad de 'og rlung thub tshad bskum ste steng rlung cung zad mnan la bsgom/ de'i dus su yang gsus pa tshur la zhum du mi gzhug gsungs/ de la lus thams cad drod kyis khyab pa 'byung ste/ drod byung rgyal du bskyang ngo*// de ltar rlung goms pa dang dmigs pa sna rtse las mi ring bar bzhag /sems klod la gnas par bya'o// de ni rig pa sems kyi rang so bzung ba'o// da ni bzhi pa kha sbyar zhes bya ba lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ yon tan thams cad skyed pa'i rgyu yin pas 'di sgom pa'i tshul la bzhi las/ nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ rkang pa skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya lte 'og tu mnan pa'am pus mo la bkab pa'i bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu tshang bar byas la lte bar gtum mo'i me a shad kyi rnam pa lta bu phra zhing tsha la rno ba ngar dang ldan par bsam/ de nas dang por 'og rlung cung zad bskum/ de nas (384)steng rlung sgra med par mgo sa la thug pa tsam gyi rtsol bas rim gyis drangs la rlung thams cad lte ba'i me la thim par bsgom pa'am dmigs pa ci la'ang mi gtad par bsgom/ steng rlung rdzogs pa dang mchil ma cig mid la 'og rlung drag tu 'then nas rlung lte ba'i gnas su kha sbyor la pho ba tshigs pa la gcer/ gsus po che phyir phul la mgrin pa cung zad dgug /nor bu og mas non tsam byas la rlung thub tshad du bzung*/ de'i tshe 'og rlung bskum pas steng rlung rang 'gags su 'gro ba dang*/

steng rlung mnan pas 'og rlung shugs kyis 'then par 'gro zhing phyir btang yang 'gror ma 'dod na yon tan rin po che skye ba'i mchog yin no// de'ang rlung non pa'i tshad ni/ rtsol ba yang rab rgyun mi chad// rtsol ba rab la drug cu bzhi// rtsol ba 'bring la sum cu gnyis// rtsol ba tha ma nges pa med// ces bya ste thun la sbyar na/ yang rab kyis kha sbyar rgyun mi chad par 'ong*/ rab kyis thun re la kha sbyar drug cu rtsa bzhi re 'ong*/ 'bring gis thun re la sum cu rtsa gnyis/ tha mas nges pa med par bsgom zhes gsung zhing 'di ni gtsor mi mdzad do// kha sbyar re'i tshad la sbyar na/ pus mo la bskor ba re dang se gol gtogs pa re spel ba ste/ de'ang khams dang zas bzang ba/ dad brtson che ba'i gang zag gis thun gyi nges pa med par nyin mtshan rgyun mi 'chad par 'ong*/ de bas khams dang rtsol ba zhan pa'i gang zag gis dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi dag pa'i dbang du byas nas thun gcig la kha sbyar drug cu rtsa bzhi 'ong*/ de las khams dang rtsol ba zhan pa'i gang zag 'bring pos chu tshod sum cu rtsa gnyis dag pa'i dbang du byas nas thun gcig la kha sbyar sum se gol cu rtsa gnyis 'ong*/ dad pa dang brtson 'grus tha mas thun re la bdun nam bcu se gol/ 'am nyer gcig la sogs pa nges pa med par 'byung ba yin no// de la nyi ma re re'am thun re re la re re 'phel du (385)bcug nas tha ma yang rab tu 'gyur ba yin no// de ltar lus skyil krung la ci tsam 'dod pa thub nas spyod lam gyi sgo nas sbyang bar bya ste/ tsog pur sbyang*/ de la 'byongs nas langs la sbyang*/ de nas las byed pa la sogs pa bya ba thams cad kyi sgo nas kyang sbyang bar bya'o// rjes la lta ba bskyang ba ni/ gsal ba rang so bzung ba dang*/ lhug par rang so bzung bar bya'o// mthar phyin pa'i tshad nyin mtshan du ma kha sbyar thub cing lus kyi 'phrul 'khor bcas pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur ba'o// 'og rlung dran pa tsam gyis thams cad rang 'gags su 'gro ba'o// skyon 'byung ba lus 'khrugs la sogs pa'i skyon sel/

yon tan bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin mnyam rjes med par skye/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'grub pa yin no// de dag gi gegs bsal ba gzhung nyid du shes par bya'o// gnyis pa khyab bya man ngag gi gnad ni/ spyir tsaṇ+ḍa lī sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa la dmigs pa gsal ba gces/ rlung non chung yang dmigs pa gsal na nyams bzang po skye/ mi gsal na rlung non che yang dmigs pa mi gsal ba ltar nyams skye ba bul la/ 'dir 'bar 'dzag thams cad snying ga yan chad du dmigs pa gtad na nyams gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye/ rlung non chung*/ lte ba man chad la gtad na drod bde ba gtsor skye/ rlung non che ba yin no// dmigs pa thams cad yang yang spong pa bas/ dmigs pa gcig la gnad zin pa gal che zhing*/ rlung dang gtum mo de dag kyang*// nam zla dang*/ na tshod dang*/ nad gzhi dang sbyar dgos te/ rlung dbyar/ gtum mo dgun/ mi rtog pa dpyid/ bde ba'i nyams myong skye bar 'dod na ston sgom pa yin no// yang gzhon dus rlung*/ dar la bab pa na gtum mo// rgas pa na mi rtog pa/ yang khrag mkhris che ba la rlung*/ rlung shas che (386na gtum mo bsgom pa'o// de dag gi nyams su blang ba'i man ngag mdor bsdu na dgur 'dus te/ 'khor lo la ma brten pa lnga/ brten pa gsum/ man ngag gi gnad la brten pa myur ba'o// dang po la lnga'i/ mar me gso ba la brgyad las/ lam sbyang ba ni/ lus tsog pu lag pa sgom thag gi phyag rgyar gnad la phab pa'i bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du song bas srog rtsol gyi rlung gang rung gis bsam gtan gyi lam btsal te lte ba'i 'og sor bzhir k+ṣa yig dmar nag mgo thur la blta ba me'i rang bzhin du gnas pa dang*/ lte bar aṃ kha dog dmar skya mgo gyen du blta ba gsal btab la 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor ba lan gsum gyi tha ma la bsdams pas rlung mar rtse sprad pas sum mdo'i me 'bar ba k+ṣa yig la phog pas me cher 'bar/

de lte ba'i aṃ la phog pa las khams bdud rtsi'i rgyun cha phra ba babs pas mar me'i sdong bu la 'bru mar blugs pa ltar k+ṣa'i me gsos par bsam/ dmigs pa de dag bsgom pa'i tshe mi gsal na mig btsum ste bsgoms kyang chog la/ gsal zhing drag la yun thung ba// gtum mo'i sbyor ba dag la bslab// ces pa ltar bslab ste/ dmigs pa 'dzin pa'i bar la rlung mi 'jug pa yin no// de ltar dmigs pa gsal ba dang steng rlung rngubs te rlung gi rta mchil ma gcig kyang sgra med du mid la kos kos ol mdud non par bya ste 'bar 'dzag sgra shad 'dzing pa lta bu'i rnam pa la drag tu dmigs shing 'og sgo 'then nas rlung ran tshad du kha sbyor ro// gnyis pa lta ba bskyang ba ni ting nge 'dzin dngos te sngar gyi dmigs pa de las lus sems la nyams ci skyes brtags pas nyams bco lnga po gang rung zhig skyes nas de la sems rtse gcig tu gnas na rlung sems kyi rtsol ba klod de/ lus sems khong lhod klod la gsal ba'am lhug pa ngos bzung la mi g.yo bar bzhag go /(387)yang sems 'phro na lam sbyang ba'i rlung sems kyi rtsol ba de nyid drag tu bsgom pa'o// de ltar lam sbyang ba dang*/ lta ba bskyang ba gnyis spel zhing bya ba'am/ yang na lam sbyang ba gtso bor byas nas thun zhabs su lta ba skyong ba blo la gang bde bya'o// gsum pa drod byung rgyal du bskyang ba ni/ mtshan nyid sna tshogs la sogs pa nyams mtho dman bde sdug ci skyes kyang nang gi rten 'brel las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin du ngo shes par byas la skyon yon du mi lta zhing dga' mi dga'i rnam rtog spangs te lam du bsral lo// bzhi pa thun grangs med pa ni/ nyi ma gcig la thun bzhi dang drug la sogs pa'i nges pa med par bsgom pa'o// lnga pa thun tshad med pa ni/ thun re la grangs nyer bzhir bcad nas bsgom pa la sogs pa'i tshad med pa'o// drug pa yid 'jug yul brtags pa ni/

yid spro na bsgom la mi spro na mi bsgom ste/ spro bzhin du ma bsgom na bogs mi 'byung*/ mi spro bzhin bsgom na gegs su gyur te/ rta gdong 'drog can dang 'dra bar lan cig sgom dang 'gras na phyis kyang ngan lang du song nas bsgom du mi btub ba'o// bdun pa khams tshod bzung ba ni/ khams bzang na bsgom la ngan na khams gso zhing re zhig klod pa ste/ khams jan bzhin du sgom na 'byung ba lus 'khrugs su 'gyur ba'o// brgyad pa kha zas dang spyod lam gyi lcag gis bsnun pa ni/ kha zas yang zhing bcud che ba za/ spyod lam ha cang gcur ba ma yin pa bag yangs brten/ nyi ma dang me dang rlung la mi bsdad/ rngul 'ong du mi gzhug /lus gnad skyil krung ngam tsog pu la bslab bo// gnyis pa tshangs pa'i thog la brgyad las// lam sbyang ba ni/ bla ma'i gsung gis/ rlung gi gzhu la me yi mda'// byang sems haṃ gi 'ben la brdeg /(388)myur tu ye shes 'char bar 'gyur// bskyar ba'i sbyor ba med pa'o// zhes pa'i don te/ lus skyil krung*/ lag pa gnyis pus mo la dgab/ lus gnad gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba'i bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du btang nas sems kyi gnad gshang sgor rlung gi gzhu la me'i mda' tsha ba rtsub pa rno ngar dang ldan pa mar rtse gshang lam du bstan pa gsal gdab/ rtsa dbu ma yang gsang gnas nas spyi gtsug gi bar du drang por yod pa'i yas snar haṃ mgo thur bstan byang sems kyis gang ba bsgoms la/ rlung gi gnad 'og rlung drag shul du bskum/ lto ba'i smad tshigs pa la sbyar bas rgyab phyogs ngos nas mda' gzhu steng 'og 'gyur te mdel rtse dbu mar zhugs par bsam/ de nas ro stod gyen du 'then pas gzhu khengs par gyur pa na lto ba'i smad dang 'og rlung steng du drag tu drangs/ mig steng du bgrad pas me'i mda' de dbu ma'i lam nas song*/ spyi gtsug gi haṃ la phog pas haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun pa thag nar ba'am/

mu tig gi rdog ma lta bu dkar krig krig 'dzag pa rigs gnyis po blo la bde ting nge ba'i bar du 'bab par bsgoms la 'og rlung dang ro stod dus gcig tu klod/ gsus po che phyir drag tu phul la lto ba tshigs pa la gcer/ de nyid kyis steng rlung rang 'gags su 'gro bas ched du bzung mi dgos la/ ched du'ang mi gtong ste 'di ni rlung zhi ba zhes bya ba'i gnad yin no// de'i tshe sems 'phro na mda' gzhu'i dmigs pa ni mi bsgom gyi/ snying ga'am lte ba yan chad du thig le 'dzag pa la yid gtad/ ting nge 'dzin shugs drag pas brgyal na/ tshigs pa bdun pa'i phyi nang du khu tshur dang thal lcag gis bsnun/ des ma phan na chu lcag la sogs pa bya zhing man ngag gi gnad brgyad kyis nyams su blang ba sngar bzhin no// thun phyi ma phyi ma mda' gzhu'i dmigs pa re re bsgom du yod do// lta ba bskyang (389)ba la sogs pa sngar bzhin no// 'di las gtso bor drod dang bde ba skye'o// gsum pa rtsa'i rnal 'byor la/ lam sbyong ba ni/ lus skyil krung la sogs pa ci bder gnad la dbab/ sngon 'gro gzhan rnams kyang tshang bar byas nas rlung phyir ldang ba dang bstun te g.yas ro ma ma'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar po gsang gnas nas rna ba g.yas kyi bar la gsal gdab/ dbugs nang du gnas pa dang bstun te g.yon rkyang ma zla ba chu'i rang bzhin kha dog dkar po gsang gnas nas rna ba g.yon pa'i bar du gsal btab ste/ de gnyis ni sbom phra snyug ma 'bring po tsam mo// dbugs nang du gnas pa dang bstun te gsang gnas nas tshangs bug gi bar du gnas pa'i dbu ma chos bzhi ldan du gsal gdab pa ni pad+ma'i snal ma ltar phra/ chu shing gi sdong po ltar drang*/ til gyi mar me ltar gsal/ rgya skag gi me tog ltar dmar zhes dran par bya ste/ thog mar phyir 'gro ba je thung nang du 'jug pa je ring*/ phyi nas gnas pa je ring la bslab bo// de ltar yang nas yang du sbyangs pas yid gar gnas nges pa med par gang gnas sar gtad la bsgoms pas nyams dpag tu med pa skye la/

drod nyams thams cad byung rgyal du btang zhing thun tshad la sogs pa nges pa med par bya ba sogs sngar bzhin no// 'di las mi rtog pa gtso bor skye'o// bzhi pa srub shing gi 'khor lo ni/ lam sbyang ba ni lus tsog pu/ lag pa sgom thag gi phyag rgya bca'/ sngon 'gro gzhan sngar dang 'dra bar byas nas sems kyi gnad lus kyi dbus lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar du rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar po/ sbom phra ci rigs pa zhig gsal gdab/ rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis kha dog dkar po sbom phra ci rigs pa gsal btab la rlung steng rlung mnan pas rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis ltang gang pas lag pas bsrubs (390)shing sgril ba ltar rtsa gnyis kyi mdud pas bcer te dbu ma la bsrub cing bsgril bar bsgom pa'am/ yang na rtsa gnyis kyis srub thag gi tshul gyis lan gsum du dkris pas dbu ma bsgril bas dbu ma'i mas snas lte ba'i a thung srub gtan gyi tshul du 'og na yod pa la bsrubs pas phra phra har har song bar bsams la/ 'og rlung bskum ste steng rlung dang 'og rlung gnyis drag tu kha sbyar ro// 'di'ang zas dang spyod lam gyi lcag gis bskul zhing thun grangs dang thun tshad med par lam sbyang*/ lta ba bskyang*/ nyams ci skyes byung rgyal du bskyang ba la sogs pa sngar bzhin no// 'di la gtso bor drod dang bde ba skye'o// lnga pa thig le'i rnal 'byor ni bzhi las/ gsal bar 'dod na snying ga'i nyi zla kha sbyor/ gnas par 'dod na lte ba'i dpa' bo 'ba' zhig /bde ba che ba 'dod na gsang gnas bde ba'i thig le/ lus stobs 'phel bar 'dod na mdzod spu skra dkar sa bon la bslab bo// dang po ni/ mā hā mā yā'i dgongs pa ste/ skyil krung dang lag pa pus mo la dgab pa'am mnyam gzhag gang rung du gnad la phab pa'i lus gnad sogs bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu tshang bar byas nas/ snying sgo nga stong pa lta bu'i nang du 'og tu zla ba/ steng du nyi ma/

de gnyis sran ma bkas pa tsam/ bar du thig le nyungs 'bru tsam kha dog dkar dmar rnam pa gsal ba/ ngo bo bde stong chos gsum ldan cig bsam/ de la yid gtad pas thig le las sing zer ba'i sgra la bsten nas steng gi nyi ma la bu ga rta rnga shong ba tsam cig byung bar bsam/ de na mar yid kyis lta zhing rlung kha nas sgra med du bkang bas bu ga nas thig le la sib sib thim/ de la brten nas rlung gnas pa'i tshe na thig le de las 'od zer gyi skud pa shin tu phra ba cig byung ste/ bug pa nas 'thon nas nyi zla thig le dang bcas pa la dkris phyed dang bdun dkris par bsam zhing rlung thub tshad mnan/ mi thub pa dang sna nas sgra med du dal bus btang zhing sngar gyi thag pa de nang du bsngogs nas thig le la thim par bsam mo// de la nyi zla ni thabs shes/ thig le ni kun gzhi/ (391)de las byung ba'i dkris phyed ni nyon yid/ hril bo drug ni rnam shes tshogs drug ste de ltar bsgom pas ting nge 'dzin dmigs pa gsal ba rab kyi mthar thug pa skye zhing*/ gzhan mngon shes myur du 'char ro// man ngag gi gnad ni snga ma bzhin no/ gnyis pa ni/ sngon 'gro spyi dang mthun pa las khyad par du lus skyil krung du bya/ lte bar thig le can ka'i tshad tsam kha dog dkar ba/ rnam pa gsal ba/ bde stong zung du chud pa chos gsum ldan pa cig bsams la/ steng rlung rtsol ba bkag ste srog nas sam/ kha nas sgra med du dgang ste mnan pas thig le la thim par bsams pas lte bar drang skye zhing khyad par du mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni gnyid mthug po tsam myur du skye'o// man ngag gi gnad rnams snga ma bzhin no// gsum pa ni sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra/ sems kyi gnad thabs kyi rdo rje bum pa'am shes rab kyi bha ga'i nang du thig le kha dog pad+ma rā ga lta bu/ rnam pa bde gsal/ ngo bo zung 'jug chos gsum ldan yungs 'bru tsam zhig bsams la 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor bas 'og rlung thig le la thim par bsam/

de'ang 'og sgo 'dzum pa dang*/ 'og rlung cher bskum la bsgom glod tsa na dal bus glod/ drag shul du glod na thig le nyams te 'gro gsung*/ de ltar bsgoms pas nor bu 'gas pa snyam byed pa'i bde ba 'byung*/ thig le 'dzag pa'am chags pa skyes na bgrad pa'i mthas bsrung*/ mdzod spur shes pa gtad/ des zhi/ de tsam na lto ba 'gyur ba byas pas lus thams cad la bde bas khyab pa skye'o// de ltar bsgoms pas skyugs pa 'phro 'chad/ 'byangs na nad 'thon te bde mchog nas 'byung ba'o// man ngag gi gnad rnams sngar bzhin no// 'di la 'og rlung 'ba' zhig gtsor bya/ ting nge 'dzin bde ba (392)myur du skye'o// bzhi pa sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra/ sems kyi gnad mdzod spu'i nang gi spyi bo'i gnas su haṃ 'khyog po kha nang bstan mgo thur du blta ba dar gyi snal ma 'dra ba 'od dkar po 'phro zhing bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa dang*/ lce chung gi rtsa bar suṃ dkar po mgo thur bstan snying gar hūm̐ sngon po mgo gyen bstan bsams la rtsol ba'i rlung phyir rgyu ba'i dus su lce chung gi rgyab nas song nas haṃ la phog pas haṃ bsros te/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun lce chung gi suṃ la babs/ de khengs nas de las kyang bdud rtsi babs pas snying ga'i hūm̐ tshim par bsam/ de la shes pa gtad/ yang nang du 'jug pa na yang snga ma ltar babs par bsgoms la 'dzag pa gnyis sems nyams dang sbyar/ skabs su lce rtsa 'gul ba tsam bya/ lkog mas ol mdud mnan/ lce rkan la sbyar te bsgoms pas mchil ma thog mar ska ru 'gro/ de nas zho tsam/ de nas mang du song ste khams kyi zas la 'dod chags dang bral ba 'byung*/ mchil ma phyir mi 'dor ba gnad yin/ dor na khams ngan zhing longs spyod dman du 'gro gsung*/ rlung srog rtsol 'ba' zhig dang bstun/ yon tan lus zung shin tu rgyas pa dang*/ lus rta ltar 'gro/ skra dkar dang gnyer ma spong zhing shes pa gsal zhing dwangs par 'gyur ro// man ngag gi gnad rnams sngar bzhin no// de dag gis 'khor lo la ma brten pa lnga bstan to// gnyis pa 'khor lo la brten pa la/

'khor lo gcig la brten pa rno ba ni/ lus tsog pur gnad la phab/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag gzhan rnams tshang bar byas la/ gshang sgor las kyi rlung dang*/ sum mdor ye shes kyi me rang bzhin gyis gnas pa gsal gdab/ lte ba'i 'khor lo'i phyi skor drug cu rtsa bzhi la yi ge bkod pa dang bral ba/ nang skor 'dab ma brgyad la sde tshan gyi (393)gtso bo a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha brgyad g.yas bskor/ lte bar aṃ shin tu cha phra ba lte ba'i rtsa mdud gru gsum gyi dbus su gnas pa bsams te/ yig 'bru thams cad kha dog dmar po gsal gdab/ 'og rlung a long 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor bas mar rtse sprad pas sum mdo'i me sbar/ des lte ba'i aṃ la phog pas/ aṃ las me kha dog dmar zhing ngo bo tsha ba sor bzhi tsam la sogs par 'bar ba la dmigs pa gtad de rlung rim gyis kha sbyar// kos kos ol mdud mnan/ rlung thub tshad du bzung*/ des lte ba'i 'og tu drod tsha 'ur gyis 'ong ba'am/ bde bas brgyal nas 'gro ba'am/ grang sing gis 'gro ba'am/ smin mtshams na ba la sogs pa 'byung srid pas byung rgyal du btang*/ lte ba bskyang ba la sogs pa gnad rnams snga ma bzhin no// nyams myur du skye ba'i dmigs pa yin pas rno ba zhes bya'o// 'khor lo gnyis la brten pa myur ba ni/ sngon 'gro sngar bzhin byas la sems kyi gnad sngar gyi lte ba'i 'khor lo'i steng du snying gar rtsa 'dab brgyad la yi ge bkod pa dang bral ba kha thur du blta ba/ lte ba la hūm̐ sngo skya dngul chu lta bur thur la bltas pa thigs la khad pa zhig bsam/ de nas aṃ dang hūm̐ gnyis rtsa dbu ma shin tu cha phra bas zung sbrel bar bsams la de nas yang rlung mar rtse sprad de/ 'byed 'dzum lan gsum gyi tha ma la bsdams pas sum mdo'i me 'bar nas/ lte ba'i aṃ la bsnon pas/ aṃ las me shin tu phra ba dbu ma'i nang nas hūm̐ gi bar du 'bar/ hūm̐ las byang sems cha phra ba aṃ gi bar du 'dzag pas 'bar 'dzag dkar dmar gyi rnam pa la blo gtad de bsgom mo// dmigs pa 'dzin pa'i bar la steng rlung bcug na mgron po tshong ma tshar bar zong zad pa dang 'dra bas mi gzhug

/dmigs pa gsal gdab pa (394)tshar ba dang steng rlung dal bus mnan/ 'og rlung drag pos bskum/ mnan drag na dmigs pa mi gsal du 'gro srid cing*/ dmigs pa mi gsal na rlung non yang yon tan mi skye bas ran par bya/ mi thub na dal bus btang*/ man ngag gi gnad sngar bzhin no// de la drod kyis bsdus pa'i mthong snang 'byung ba ni rtags lnga dang*/ rtags kyi rtags lnga dang bcu'o// dang po ni sna g.yas nas 'byung ba lnga'i rlung lugs 'byung du rgyu ba zin pa'i dbang du byas na/ du ba/ smig rgyu/ srin bu me khyer/ mar me 'bar ba/ nam mkha' sprin med lta bu 'byung ngo*// g.yon gyi 'byung ba lnga'i rlung lugs ldog tu rgyu ba zin pa'i dbang du byas na/ mun nag /'ja' tshon/ glog /zla ba'i 'od zer/ nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu rnams 'byung ste/ mnyam rjes gnyis ka la mthong snang dang*/ rmi nyams su ci rigs par 'byung bas ngo shes par byas la nyams thams cad byung rgyal du bskyang ngo*// gsum pa 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa ni/ sngon 'gro rnams sngar bzhin byas la las byed pa'i 'khor lo gnyis kyang gsal gdab/ lte ba'i 'khor lo phyi skor 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi la ā li bcu drug phrag gnyis g.yon skor/ ha dang k+ṣa spangs pa'i kā li g.yas skor/ nang skor 'dab ma brgyad snga ma dang 'dra ste yi ge thams cad kyang kha dog dmar po mgo gyen la blta ba'o// de nas snying ga'i 'dab ma brgyad la phyogs bzhir/ bh+rūṃ āṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ bzhi/ mtshams bzhir lāṃ māṃ bāṃ tāṃ bzhi/ dbus su hūm̐ yig 'bru thams cad kyang kha dog nag po mgo thur la blta ba'o// mgrin par 'dab ma bcu drug la ā li bcu drug g.yon bskor lte bar oṃ/ yig 'bru thams cad kyang kha dog dmar po mgo gyen la blta ba'o// spyi bor 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis la ā li bcu drug g.yon skor// ka nas ta rnams so'i bar bcu drug g.yas skor/

lte ba la haṃ (395)ste yig 'bru thams cad kha dog dkar po mgo thur la blta ba'o// de bzhin du rtsa gsum yang gsal gdab ste/ g.yas ro ma dmar po/ g.yon rkyang ma dkar po lte ba nas spyi bo'i bar du zug pa/ dbus su dbu ma chos bzhi ldan lte ba nas tshangs sgor slebs par bsgom/ de nas 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum kyi sbyor bas rlung me ma dang gnyid ma gnyis rtse sprad pas sum mdo'i me sbar/ lte ba'i aṃ la phog pas rlung drod kyi rang bzhin can de g.yas ro ma nas song*/ snying ga'i yig 'bru'i khams rnams bsregs/ yang ro ma nas song mgrin pa'i yig 'bru'i khams rnams bcom/ yang ro ma nas song ste spyi gtsug gi haṃ la phog pas/ haṃ 'od du zhu nas rkyang ma nas babs/ mgrin pa'i yig 'bru rnams spar bzhin gsol btab rgyas par byas/ rkyang ma nas song snying ga'i yig 'bru rnams gsos btab rgyas par byas/ yang rkyang ma nas song ste lte ba'i aṃ la phog pas aṃ cher 'bar te dbu ma nyid cung zad kha bye nas glog gi zer ma'i tshul gyis dbu ma nas song ste snying ga'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i oṃ gnyis kyang zhen thogs med par bcom ste/ reg pa tsam gyis haṃ las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun cha phra ba dbu ma nyid nas babs/ oṃ de rim gyis mar bdas nas mgrin pa'i gnas su 'bar 'dzag la blo gtad la bsgom/ yun ring na rlung non dka' zhing*/ lce chung 'bab nyen yod/ de nas snying gang gtad de bsgom/ yun ring na snying 'dar zhing sprugs nyen yod/ mthar lte ba'i steng sor bzhi tsam gyi gnas su yid 'jug pa'i sar 'bar 'dzag la dmigs la rlung ran chad du kha sbyar du bskyang*/ lhag ma ni snga ma bzhin no// gsum pa man ngag gi gnad la brten pa la bdun las/ me dmar skya'i dmigs pa ni/ lus tsog bu rkang pa bsnol/ lag pa gnyis dpung pa la bsnol mar dgab ste phyi lus kyi thab (396)'gal drug /nang rtsa'i thab 'gal drug

/gsang ba byang chub sems kyi thab 'gal drug ste bco brgyad bca'/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag gzhan rnams tshang bar bya/ de nas rang gi lus khong stong rgyu ma bus pa ltar dmigs la gang nas byung cha med par me dmar skyas lus kyi nang gang bar bsam zhing shes pa me la gtad/ rlung rtsol ba bkag ste srog nas rngubs nas thub tshad du bsnan la yid kyis gcig gnyis la sogs pa'i grangs bgrangs pa'i rlung sbyor bcu gnyis dang*/ grangs ma bzung bar thub tshad du mnan pa'i grangs med kyi rlung sbyor bcu gnyis spel zhing bya/ thams cad bsdams pas grangs can grangs med nyi shu rtsa bzhis thun tshad bzung ste/ grangs can rtsol ba ste tshar bcad pa grangs med glod pa ste phan gdags pa/ yang grangs can lam du 'jug pa grangs med lta ba bskyang ba'o// yid 'jug yul mi rtag ste thun tshad thun grangs ma rdzogs bar du yid mi 'jug kyang 'bad de bsgom/ rdzogs nas yid spro yang mi bsgom/ khams tshod mi bzung ste khams ngan yang ngal gso yin tshad du bskyangs/ de nas khams bde yang mi bsgom/ zas dang spyod lam gyi lcag gis bskul/ nyams thams cad byung rgyal du btang*/ lta ba bskyang*/ thun bzhi'i nges pas bya/ gang zag rab zhag gsum/ 'bring lnga/ tha ma dgu na dmigs pa 'pho ste/ rab 'bring yang drod nyams skye ba myur bul lo// de nas skyes pa brtan pa'i don du sems kyi gnad sna tshogs su 'phro ba las/ gnyis pa me 'bar ba'i dmigs pa ni/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi sngar dang 'dra ba las rkang mthil gnyis su raṃ dmar nag bsam/ de nas rkang pa'i rgyu ma khug brkyang bskum gyi sbyor bas/ me 'bar long bu'i rtsa nas yong*/ brla'i rtsa bo che nas zhugs/ gsang gnas su 'dzom pas/ rno ba/ myur ba/ drag pa rtsub pa'i me la dmigs pa gtad de/ (397)rno ba ni khab kyi rtse lta bu/ myur ba ni mar me rlung gis bskyod pa lta bu/ drag pa ni reg bya tsha ba/

rtsub pa ni me stag 'phro ba ste gzhan thams cad tshul snga ma bzhin no// dmigs pa de gsal ba dang*/ gsum pa thig le'i 'thab mo ni/ sngar gyi me de'i rtser thig le dkar po sran ma tsam bsam de'i sor bzhi tsam gyi steng du thig le dmar po ril ma tsam bsams te/ de gnyis rlung kha sbyar ba'i tshe sgong 'thabs pa ltar gcig gis gcig la thug thug brgyab pas lus thams cad me stag tu phra phra bas gang ba la yid gtad do// de la brtan pa dang*/ bzhi pa 'khor lo'i dmigs pa ni/ gsang gnas kyi me de mchod rten gyi srog shing ltar drang thang gis song ba'i steng du thig le de'i steng du yang me'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'am brgyad pa rtsibs re la ā li ring thung gnyis gnyis mgo sprod du 'phyang ba/ mdun rgyab dang*/ g.yas g.yon du lte ba dang tshigs pa mkhal ma gnyis la ma reg par yod pa de g.yas g.yon gang bder 'khor bas lus kyi nang thams cad me stag gis gang bar bsam ste/ 'og rlung drag tu bskum/ steng rlung kha sbyor/ 'di la nang srog shing gi gnad dang bar 'khor lo'i gnad/ phyi yi ge 'bru bkod gyi gnad gsum gsum gces so// lnga pa me drag tu 'bar ba'i dmigs pa ni/ dmigs pa snga ma'i steng du me'i 'khor lo las me kha dog dmar nag ngo bo tsha ba/ rang bzhin mnyen pas mgrin pa man chad gang ba shug pa'i lo ma la me 'bar ba'i tshul du me lce phra phra 'phro ba dang bcas pa bsam/ nga la brtan pa dang*// drug pa me cher 'bar ba la dmigs pa ni/ me de cher song bas lus phyi nang thams cad lcags kyi gong bya bsregs pa bzhin me 'bar bar bsam/ de nas bdun pa thams cad me 'bar ba la dmigs pa ni/ me de rgya je che je cher song nas snang ba'i dngos po thams cad mer 'bar ba la shes pa gtad/ rjes lta ba skyong ba ni thun zhabs su sems dmigs pa 'dzin pa'i (398)rtsol ba glod la/ mig thad kar hur re bzhag pas mi rtog pa mtha' dbus med pa'i nyams skyes te/

de nyid la sems blan nas bzhag pas zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur ro// gnad gzhan snga ma rnams dang 'dra zhing*/ dmigs pa rnams snga ma snga ma'i steng du phyi ma phyi ma bstan nas bsgom pa yin no// 'di dag kyang rab kyis zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig /'bring gis so lnga/ tha mas drug cu rtsa gsum bsgoms pas mthar phyin pa yin no// de rnams kyi gegs bsal thabs rnams gzhung nyid du shes par bya'o// 'di rnams kyi skabs su bogs 'byin rnam pa brgyad kyis bogs dbyung ba dang*/ gdams ngag drug gi gnad kyang 'di dag gi skabs su dgos pa yin no// de ltar gtum mo'i man ngag gis lam sbyang zhing*/ lta ba rang byung gi ye shes rnyed rnyed du bsgom mo// 'dis khams 'dus pa dang por 'gro ste bsrung ba sum cu dang gegs sel rnams kyang lhas che par 'di dag gi skabs su dgos pa yin no// de nas gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi lam bsgom pa la/ lam rgyas pa dang*/ bsdus pa gnyis kyi dang po la sbyor ba 'du shes gsum gyi byin gyi brlabs pa/ dngos gzhi dbab bzung gis ngos bzung ba/ rjes ldog khyab kyis mi nyams par bsrung ba'o// dang po ni/ ye shes kyi rig ma la brten pa yin pas bdag dang ye shes kyi rig ma gnyis ka yan lag bzhi'am skad cig gis lhar gsal btab la/ gnyis kas zlos par bsams te yi dam gyi rtsa sngags la sogs pa ci rigs par bzla/ de nas mkha' gsang byin gyi brlabs te/ yum gyi mkha' tha mal pa mi dmigs te stong pa las āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la āḥs mtshan par byin gyis brlab/ yab kyi tha mal pa'i gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i stong pa las hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse mo lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ (399)sbu gur phaṭa dmar nag mgo gyen la blta ba nor bu la mu tig gi phreng ba'i dod oṃ gyi phreng bas byin gyis brlabs pa/ sa las rin po che'i tog dang bcas pa bsam/

de nas bdag gis ye shes kyi rig ma la brten nas tha mal gyi rnam rtog spangs te lhan skyes kyi ye shes mngon du byas nas chos sku thob par bya snyam du 'dun pa dar cig btang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya de'i gzugs la blta zhing 'dod chags kyi me sbar bas thig le dbab/ bde ba gar skyes ngos gzung la gang skyes pa de nyid la yid rtse gcig tu bzhag /nyams pa 'dra na bgrad pa'i mthas bsrung ste/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis brang du bsnol/ lto ba tshigs pa la bcar/ mig nam mkha' la zlog /gsang thub par bya ste/ dngos su snyoms 'jug mi bya'o// de thams cad la nyams byung rgyal du bskyang*/ de'ang chags pa'i gtam gyi sgra/ phyag rgya'i lus kyi dri/ ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi la sogs pa'i ro// lus kyi stod smad la reg pa dang*/ so dang sen mo gdab pa dang*/ 'khyud pa dang tsum+bha/ dkar 'dzin nyed pa la sogs pa reg bya sna tshogs la reg par bsam/ des 'dod chags kyi me sbar ba sogs snga ma bzhin no// de nas bo la dang kak+ko la sbyar bar bsam zhing*/ thig le dbab/ bde ba bsgom/ bgrad pa'i mthas bsrung*/ gsang thub par bya/ bsrub pa'i dmigs pa'i sbyor ba mi bya/ de nas ru sbal gyi 'gros te dal bus bsrubs pas thig le dbab/ bde ba nyams pa 'dra na steng gi nam mkha' dang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dang 'og min la sogs par 'phang*/ bgrang ba'i mthas bsrung*/ thig le bzung dka' na steng rlung rnam par 'gog pa'i sbyor bas drangs te/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis sna bug g.yas bkag ste srog nas bkang la mgo lus thams cad g.yas bskor du bskor la ro stod gsig /mgo sprug /de las (400)thig le zin na rtags gzhung du bstan pa bzhin du 'byung*/ de'i tshe bde stong zung du chud nas bde ba ngos gzung dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye bas ngos zin par byas la yun ci ring du bskyang ngo*// gsum pa la gsum las/

thig le gyen du bzlog pa ni/ lus 'gyur bzhi/ ngag sems kyi 'gyur ba gnyis te/ 'gyur ba drug gis steng du 'phangs pa'o// drug pa na/ rgya mtsho ri rab la skam/ gling bzhi dbang du bsdu/ ro 'dzin rang gi gnas su sbyar/ dbang po'i mchog steng du bgrang*/ ngag stobs kyi hūm̐ drag la ring bas drangs/ ting nge 'dzin hūm̐ phaṭa kyi mda' gzhu 'phang ba ste/ dang po ni/ gsus po che phyir phul la/ lto ba sgal tshigs la bcer ba/ gnyis pa rkang lag gi sor mo rnams dus gcig tu drag tu bskums nas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis snying gar bsnol te nywa bzhi bsgrim pa/ gsum pa lce rkan la sbyar nas nang du zlog pa/ bzhi pa mig bgrad nas spyi gtsug gi nam mkha' la blta ba/ lnga pa rlung nang du 'jug pa dang bstun nas hūm̐ gi sgra drag la ring bas nang rlung gyen du drang zhing rgyu zhabs rim gyis bskum/ drug pa sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus kyi gsang ba'i hūm̐ des phaṭa 'dren/ phaṭa kyis hūm̐ phul te gsang gnas nas spyi gtsug gi bar du rim gyis drangs par bsam ste/ de rnams dus gcig la bya'o// gnyis pa lus kun la khyab par bya ba ni/ rlung gi ska rags bcings/ zhags pa 'phangs/ lus gtun shing gi 'khor lo ltar bskor/ bu chung gi spyod lam byed pa ste/ dang po lus skyil krung bcas la/ rlung nang du rngub ste thub tshad du bsnan la lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur drag tu bcang ste kha steng du bstan pa bsnol la mdun du sked pa la ska rags 'ching ba'i tshul du byed pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ gan rkyal du 'gyel la rkang lag bzhi re mos su g.yab cing brkyang pa'o// (401)gsum pa ni skyil krung bcas nas lag pa gnyis pus mo la bkab nas lto ba bskor ba'o// bzhi pa ni/ lus gnad de lta bu las mgo mdun dang g.yas g.yon du ljogs ljogs lan gsum gsum bya zhing sprug /phyogs bzhir par 'gyel tshur 'gyel bya/

dbugs si'i sgras so bar nas drag tu rngub pa'o// de dag gis ni byang chub kyi sems kyis lus thams cad la khyab par gyur te bde stong mchog tu gyur pa'i nyams skye'o// gsum pa mi nyams par bsrung ba ni/ 'dzag pa drug pa srung ba'i skabs bzhin du nyams su len pa'o// gnyis pa lam bsdus pa la gsum las/ sbyor ba thur sel dbang du bya ba ni// lus kyi spyod lam ldan byas nas// lag g.yas nyi ma g.yon pa zla// dpus mo gnyis la bsnol mar dge ba// hūm̐ ring hūm̐ thung mdun du dgu// g.yas g.yon dag tu gsum gsum ste// 'bud pa gsum dang rngub pa gsum// 'khor ma dag tu sbyar bar bya// nyi ma dag ni gsum pa ni// sba ba sbubs su nub par 'gyur// zhes pa'i sgo nas thur sel sbyangs te tshul yang gnas khang dpangs mtho bar tsog pu lag g.yas nyi ma g.yon zla bar dran par byas la pus mo gru khags su chub pa'i sgo nas lag mthil bsnol mar phyi nas bkab la rked pa bsrang*/ mgrin pa mdun du dgug la phyi rlung nang 'jug dang bstun nas nang rlung hūm̐ gi sgras thog mar ring bar drang ba gcig /de rdzogs ma thag bskyar nas 'dren pa gcig /de'i mjug tu shin tu thung ba gcig ste gsum 'brel pa can du bya/ 'og rlung yang de dang mthun par lan gsum gyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par drang zhing*/ de'i tshe srin po'i lam yang dus gcig tu lan gsum gyi bar du 'then/ gsum ka'i mthar mgo gyen la dgyed dgyed pa lan gsum gsum bya/ de'i rjes la rlung thub tshad du bzung*/ mig gyen la bgrad do// g.yas su yang de lta bu khor cig /de nas (402)yang dbus su khor cig /de nas yang g.yon du khor cig /de nas yang dbus su khor cig /de nas sna nas rlung phyir 'bud pa btud ma drag po gsum/ rngub pa btud ma gsum/ de bzhin du g.yas su gsum/ de nas g.yon du/ de lta bu gcig rting gcig 'khor mar sbyangs pas rlung chun che na nyin phyed/

tha mas kyang nyi ma gsum pa na sba ba sbubs su nub ste thur sel gyi rlung la dbang thob par 'gyur ro// ma nub kyang gsang gnas shin tu thung bar song nas thig le mi 'chor ba yin zhig tshul de lta bu khams kyis ma lcogs na dbus su gsum/ g.yas g.yon du re re bya/ de'i tshe mgo na ba dang*/ skyug bro ba byung na srin po'i lam glod/ snying tshi ba'am dri chen dri chu bsdams na gyen thur la 'gro ba dang bcag pa gal che'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbab bzung gnyis bstan pa ni/ byin gyis rlabs sogs byas nas ni// srin po'i lam ni cung zad bsdams// gung mdzub gnyis ni drag tu gzhib// mig gnyis steng du bgrad par bya// 'dis ni thig le zin par bya// yang na ha hal drag tu brjod// lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gzhan yang bya// 'dis kyang thig le zin par 'gyur// zhes pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len pa ste/ lus tsog pur gnad la dbab/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya 'du shes gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ bo la dang kak+ko la sbyar phar bskyod tshur drud pa tsam gyis thig le dbab/ bde bas mi bzod pa dang thig le bzung ba'i phyir srin po'i lam cung zad bsdams pa dang phyir phul ba res 'jog tu bya/ mig mi 'dzum pa steng du bgrad/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi gung mdzub gnyis re mos kyis khar bcug la kha nas mi phyin tsam du rlung nang du 'dren pa dang dus gcig tu drag tu gzhib ste g.yas kyi sor mo 'jib tsa na g.yon gyi mig bgrad/ g.yon gyi sor mo 'jib tsa na g.yas kyi mig bgrad/ lus 'gyur gsum po de dus gcig tu bya ste thig le nges par zin no// yang na ngag gcig pu'i 'dren (403)pas has rlung drag tu drangs pa'i mthar/ hal gyis phyir 'phul ba lan grangs mang du bya/ mthar rlung thub tshad cig bzung*/ lus kyi 'phrul 'khor gzhan steng rlung rnam par 'gog pa'i sbyor bas kyang drang ngo*/// /gsum pa rjes bzlog cing khyab bar bya ba ni/

glang chen hing dang stag mo ngur// gcan gzan skyugs dang wa ltar bsnom// lte ba snying ga mgrin pa dang*// spyi gtsug dag tu rim gyis drang*// rnam grol rgya yis lus la dgram// zhes pa'i don te/ skyil krung tsog pu la rkang pa'i brang ba sa la btsug /rting pa bteg pa'i steng du lus kyi ljid bor ba gang rung bya/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur drag tu bcangs pa snying gar bsnol/ sems kyi gnad byang sems rdo rje nor bu'i rtse nas lte bar byon par bsam zhing*/ ngag gi gnad hi'i sgras rlung phyir 'gro dang bstun te phyir phul/ hing gi nang nas rlung 'dren pa dang bstun nas steng du drangs/ de lta bu btud mar rlung gis thub tshad du bya/ de bzhin du snying gar drang par bsam zhing hus phul/ hūm̐ gis drang ba btud ma mang du bya/ mgrin par drang par bsam zhing hag hag zhes pa'i sgra btung mas nang nas drangs/ spyi gtsug tu drangs par bsam zhing rlung sna nas lan 'ga' rngubs pa'i rjes su hika ces brjod la ltag pa bgyed byas/ mig steng du bgrad nas rlung thub tshad cig bzung*/ gong gi ngag 'dren snga phyi'i mtshams su yang rlung thub tshad re bzung*/ de nas seng ge rnam grol gyi phyag rgyas khyab par bya ba ni/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bos rna ba gnyis/ mdzub mos mig gnyis/ gung mos sna bug gnyis/ mthe'u chung dang srin lag gi bar du mchu bsdams la gru mo gnyis thad kar bsrang ste/ thog mar g.yas su bskor/ de nas g.yon du bskor/ de nas gsor ltar bsgril/ de'i rjes su sna bug mthib mdzub kyi bar du bcar la rlung drag tu rngub cing mgo sprugs lus sprugs bya'o// lam 'di'i thun re'i mgor bsam (404)gtan gyi yan lag dgu dang*/ thun zhabs su lta ba bskyang*/ dge rtsa bsngo/ ma rtogs kyi sems can la snying rje bsgom pa sngar ltar sbyar bar bya ba las/ 'di'i lta ba ni bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin yin pas ngas bzung nas lus sems khong glod nas 'jog pa'o// 'di ni khams 'dus pa bar pa thig le bde stong gi lam khrid pa zhes bya ba yin no// bzhi pa dbang bzhi pa'i lam la gnyis kyi sngon 'gro ni/

gnas dben par nyi zer dang lhags pa med par stan 'bol ba rgya che ba'i steng du sngon 'gro gsum byas la/ phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis so// dang po yas rim du tshar gcig /de nas mas rim du tshar gcig /de nas gang zin zin nas thams cad tshang bar tshar gcig ste de ltar dgu bcu rtsa drug thun re la bya ste/ de lta bu thun gsum mam/ gnyis sam gcig gang grub bya/ de ma grub na yan lag lnga sbyong thun bzhi'am gsum bu nyams su blang ba sngon du 'gro ba'i bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu yun ci ring du nyams su len pa'o/// /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum las/ srog rtsol la sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i 'og rlung bskyod pa'i lus kyi rba rlabs na/ dang po sbyor rjes sngar dang 'dra ba la rlung sbyor bdun la rtags thon thon gyi bar du bsgom/ de nas lus kyi rba rlabs dngos bsgom ste/ de'ang skyil krung*/ lag pa pus mo gnyis la bkab la mnan/ rked pa drang por bsrang*/ lto ba tshigs pa la sbyar/ rlung 'bud gsum/ rngub gsum gyi tshul gyis steng rlung mnan/ tshang ra g.yas g.yon 'og tu bsnon pa re mos kyis dal gyis bskum ste drag tu 'then/ drag shul du bskum na shugs chad nas 'gro/ btang tsa na 'og rlung sngon du gtong*/ de lta bu thun grangs dang thun tshad med pa sbyangs pas lus la bde ba dang*/ sems gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur ba 'byung*/ khams 'chug pa 'dra na lto ba bskyod/ ro stod gcu/ bgrad pa'i mtha' bsrung*/ (405)sems nam mkhar 'phang*/ skabs su bogs 'byin brgyad ci rigs pas bogs dbyung ngo*// de'i tshe 'og rlung btang bas steng rlung phyir mi 'gro na gnad zin pa yin no// gnyis pa ngag 'dren pa zhi drag gi rba rlabs la gnyis las/ ngag 'dren zhi ba ni/ gnas dben par phyin la lus skyil krung lag pa rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bsnol/ mgo mdun du sa la ma reg tsam btud la i'i gdangs kyis kha nas sgra med par rlung so bar nas bzhur te/

nang rlung gyen du 'dren pa dang dus gcig tu kha nas dal bus 'drongs tshad du drangs/ de dang bstun nas rgyu zhabs dang 'og rlung yang rim gyis drag tu bskum/ mthar mgo dgyed byas la mig steng du bgrad/ rlung thub tshad du mnan/ mi thub pa dang dal bus btang*/ phyir song rdzogs ma thag yang drang*/ de lta bu mdun du gsum/ g.yas su gsum/ g.yon du gsum/ de lta bu 'khor bdun bdun la thun rer byas pa'i thun bzhir nyams su blang*/ rjes la bde stong mchog gi lta ba bskyang ngo*// gom nas gling bu lta bu'i sgra 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa ngag 'dren drag po ni/ lus ngag gi gnad sngar dang 'dra ba las khyad par hūm̐ gi sgra dang bcas pas drang*/ rim gyis skad ngar je cher btang bas mthar phyin pa na rgyang ring po nas thos pa rag dung gi skad lta bu 'byung ngo*// gzhan thun tshad la sogs pa gong dang 'dra'o// gsum pa ting nge 'dzin sems kyi rba rlabs ni/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten nas ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa ste/ 'di la gsum las/ thabs rgyud dag par bya ba ni/ yab yum gyi 'du shes gyis byin gyis brlabs nas skad cig gis snyoms par zhugs pas/ yab yum gnyis ka'i khams dwangs ma dbu ma'i sna rtsar byon/ 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur/ g.yas ro ma nas song*/ lte bar byon/ lte ba'i 'khor lo nam langs pa bzhin yal yal/ nyi ma shar ba bzhin sal sal glo ba bus pa bzhin ltang ltang*/ yang ro ma nas song snying gar chos gsum ldan du dran/ (406)yang ro ma nas song mgrin par byon chos gsum ldan du dran/ yang ro ma nas song rna ba g.yas pa nas 'od zer gyi rnam par 'phros 'od zer gyi sgo las lhag pa lha'i dal 'phros/ sems can gyi rgyud la dbang bzhi bskur/ snod gzhal yas khang bcud kyi sems can rnams lhag pa'i lhar byas/ snod bcud thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur/ phar spros pa'i 'od zer dang 'dres/

bdud rtsi'i bcud du gyur tshangs pa'i sgor zhugs/ spyi bor chos sum ldan du dran/ mgrin par byon nyi ma stong gi gzi brjid dang ldan/ snying gar byon bdag gi rgyud sku lngar bsgyur ba'i rtags su 'ong kha dog lngar gyur/ rtsa dag pa'i lam lte ba nas byung nas yum gyi mkhar snga ma bzhin gnas par bsam mo// des gzung rtog nub ro ma dbang du 'dus/ rtsol ba'i rlung la dbang thob/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma med pa mngon du byas snyam du mos pa tsam bya'o// de bzhin du g.yon du'ang bya ste/ 'dzin rtog nub/ rkyang ma dbang du 'dus/ srog rlung la dbang thob/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo smon pa med pa mngon du byas par bsam/ de bzhin du dbu mar yang bya ste/ gzung 'dzin gnyis ka'i rtog pa phra mo nub/ dbu ma sbyangs/ rlung gnas pa la dbang thob/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid mngon du byas par bsam mo// gnyis pa shes rab kyi rgyud dag par bya ba ni/ yum gyi rtsa gsum sbyong ba'i dmigs pa sngar bzhin bya ste/ rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis nas ni rna ba g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi sgor byon pa tsam las phyir spro ba ni med la/ tshangs pa'i sgo las spro ba dang bsdu ba byas kyang rung ma byas kyang rung ste 'dra bar bzhed do// gsum pa rgyud so sor dag par bya ba ni/ yab kyi dbu ma nas khams dwangs ma 'od zer gyi rnam par song nas gtsug tor mchog tu thim/ yum gyi yang de bzhin du thim ste gnyis ka'ang sku lnga lhun gyis grub par dran pa tsam bya ste/ 'di dag rlung ldang 'jug dang bstun pa dang*/ thun bzhi'i (407)nges pa mi dgos par bzhed do// de'i tshe nyams gar skyes nges pa med la/ ci skyes byung rgyal du bskyangs pas lta ba chos thams cad shin tu rnam par dag pa'i de kho na nyid mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i nyams myong rgyud la skyes te 'dis khams 'dus pa tha ma skyon med gnyug ma ye shes kyi lam khrid pa yin no// 'di dag ni gang zag tha ma rim gyis dkri ba la dgongs pa ste thun brgya nyi shu rtsa lngar byas nas 'khrid pa yin no// kha cig la snang gsum gyi khrid bor te lta ba nas skyong ba yang yod/

snang ba gsum dang*/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud dang*/ lam thabs rgyud bzhi ka dang*/ lam bzhi re res 'khrid pa yang yod de/ rgyu rgyud ma gtogs pa kun la sngon 'gro gnyis dang*/ lta bas thag bcad pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa sngon du song nas nyams su len pa yin mod kyang*/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bzhed pas bskyed rim cung zad cig brtan par byas nas lus sbyong dang*/ rlung kho na gtsor byed pa yin no// rlung dang gtum mo'i dmigs pa rnams la ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu'am lam zhes bya/ lta ba rang byung gi ye shes la ting nge 'dzin nyid ces bya ste/ de nam skyes pa na skyong ba yin no// sngar thos bsam gyis gtan la phabs pa'i lta ba de ni skyon can yin la/ 'di ni lta ba skyon med dam/ dpe'i ye shes bya ba'am/ phyag rgya chen po bya ba yin no// des na rgyu med par 'bras bu mi 'byung bas/ rgyu rlung dang gtum mo'i dmigs pa la brten nas lta ba rang byung gi ye shes lam phyag rgya chen po nas skye bar 'gyur bas na rgyu la nan tan bya'o// yang gang zag gi rigs kha cig sngar bstan pa'i khrid thams cad lo gcig tsam gyis sbyangs nas/ ngag 'dren zhi ba'ang lo gcig tsam sbyang*/ de nas ngag 'dren drag pos rlung kha sbyar la brten nas ting nge 'dzin sems kyi rba rlabs 'ba' zhig bsgom pa yod de/ 'di brtson 'grus mchog gi 'jug pa yin no// gsum pa nges shes khyad par can bskyed la/ (408)ting nge 'dzin shes par bya zhing lam gyi sa mtshams rnam par gzhag pa la gsum/ tshad ma bzhi dang snyan brgyud bzhis nges shes bskyed pa/ ting nge 'dzin ngo shes shing sa mtshams bzhag pa/ 'khor lo bskor bas grub pa'i rtags dang bcas pa'o// dang po gzhung du ston la// gnyis pa khams 'dus pa gsum/ gsum pa grub mtha' bzhi ste/ de dag gis gang zag gi sa mtshams gang slebs rtogs pas gnas skabs de'i lam gyis dkri ba'i dgos pa yod do// 'bras bu sku lnga rang bzhin gyi lhun grub ni 'bras bu'i skabs su bstan zin to// lam 'bras snying po'i khrid yin la// de yi zab don gzhung khrid las/

zab rgyas gzhung shing ji lta ba'i// khrid yig sbas don gsal bar bgyis// snyigs dus nub pas 'jigs pa'i phyir// brgyud pa'i man ngag ji bzhin du// sbas don gsal bar phye ba la// bla ma mkha' 'gros bzod par dgongs// dge bas bdag sogs 'gro ba kun// skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// lam zab 'di dang mi 'bral zhing*// myur bar sku bzhi mngon gyur cig /lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid yig sbas pa'i don gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di lta bu/ rje btsun gong ma'i khrid yig gi gsal byed bri ba'i 'dun pa yod kyang*/ bka' srung gnyan pa dang*/ le lo'i dbang gis yun ring por bri bar ma spobs pa las/ thog mar lam 'di la ches cher mos pa'i bsam gtan pa shākya bzang po zhes bya bas gser yon dang bcas pas gsal ba btab cing*/ bar du phyi nang gi gsung rab kyis rgyud yongs su sbyangs pas rig pa dang grol bar smra ba'i spobs pa can rdo rje 'dzin pa grags pa bzang po dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen grub pa dpal bzang la sogs pas gtor ma me tog dang bcas pas ches cher bskul zhing*/ mthar dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa'i dbon po kun dga' ye shes la sogs pa mang pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams rgyal (409)mtshan dpal bzang pos/ thams cad 'dul gyi lo sangs rgyas dbang bskur ba'i zla ba'i dus khyad par can mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus nyer dgu'i snga cha skar ma tha skar la bab pa'i tshe yongs su grub pa'i yi ge pa ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen shes rab rdo rje dang*/ mañdzu shrī zhes bya ba bgyis te legs par sbyar ba gnas skabs kun tu lam sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /shin tu bkra shis shing dge'o/ ༈ /gnad bcu gcig gis dkri ba gnad dug gis dkri ba/ dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyis dkri ba gsum gyi khrid bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ gnad bcu gcig gis dkri ba'i khrid kyi gsal byed gnad kyi sgo 'byed ces bya ba/

bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i rgyu lam thams cad man ngag gi gnad bcu gcig gis bgrod pa las/ 'jig rten pa'i lam la gsum gyi 'dus pa dang po lam sbyang ba khyad par can gyi gnad/ srog rtsol la sogs pa sngon du song nas/ 'og rlung bskyod pa/ lus kyi rba rlabs kyi gnad/ ngag 'dren pa zhi ba'i gnad/ ngag 'dren pa drag po'i gnad de bzhi/ 'dus pa bar pa la lta ba gso ba phyag rgya chen po'i gnad/ bogs 'byin pa rnam pa brgyad kyi gnad/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi'i gnad de gsum/ 'dus pa tha ma la yang dag par spong ba bzhi'i gnad/ ting nge 'dzin sems kyi rba rlabs kyi gnad de gnyis/ 'das pa'i lam sa bcu gnyis la dbang bzhi dang dkyil 'khor gsum gyi gnad/ mthar phyin gyi lam sa phyed la 'gros bzhi thim pa'i gnad de bcu gcig gis lam bgrod pa yin na'ang*/ nyams len la dang po bzhi/ bar pa'i thog ma gcig /gsum pa'i phyi ma ste gnad drug gis nyams su len pa la sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis kyi dang po khrid kyi sngon 'gro bsags sbyang dang*/ thun gyi sngon 'gro gnad la dbab pa gsum/ sgom pa gsum/ shes rab kyi bya ba gsum/ de dgu lam rgyas pa dang*/ dbang po rab (410)'bring gsum gyi khrid ltar nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ sbyang ba khyad par can gyi gnad la gsum gyi/ lus sbyangs pa ni gnas dben par nyi lhag med pa'i sa bde bar stan 'bol la rgya che ba'i steng du sngon 'gro dgu sngon du song bas/ phrin las sum cu so gnyis po dang po yas rim du tshar gcig /de nas mas rim du tshar gcig /de nas gang zin nas thams cad tshang bas tshar gcig ste de ltar dgu bcu rtsa drug thun re la byas te/ de lta bu thun gsum mam gnyis sam/ gcig gang grub kyi bar du bya'o// de'ang skye ba 'di la dngos grub thob par 'dod na/ lus sbyong ba gnad du che ba yin gsungs/

de nas ngag sems sbyong ba lam rgyas pa ltar bya'o// gnyis pa srog rtsol la sogs pa sngon du song nas 'og rlung bskyod pas lus kyi rba rlabs kyi gnad ni rlung sbyor bdun/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa bco brgyad lam rgyas pa ltar bsgom/ de dag gi skabs su bogs 'byin brgyad kyi gnad kyis bogs dbyung ste/ thun bri skyed gnyis/ shes pa sgrim lhod gnyis/ kha zas res 'jog spyod lam bag yangs sems kyi gnad sna tshogs su 'phro ba/ yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bsten pa ste brgyad lam bsam mi khyab ltar nyams su len pa skabs dang sbyar gyi/ thun du bcad nas sgom pa ni med do// de nas 'og rlung bskyod pa lus kyi rba rlabs dngos/ de nas ngag 'dren pa zhi ba'i gnad/ de nas ngag 'dren pa drag po'i gnad/ de nas lta ba gso ba phyag rgya chen po'i gnad/ dbang gsum pa'i lam ste gzhung ji lta ba bzhin no// de nas ting nge 'dzin sems kyi rba rlabs kyi gnad gzhung bzhin no// de dag kyang sbyong ba gsum la thun gsum/ rlung sbyor bdun/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa bco brgyad la thun nyer lnga/ lus kyi rba rlabs/ ngag 'dren zhi ba/ drag po la re re/ gsum pa'i lam la brgyad/ sems kyi rba rlabs la gsum ste/ thun zhe gnyis (411)kyis lam 'khrid pa yin no// de dag kyang thams cad kyi sbyor ba'i chos dgu/ rjes gsum thun thams cad la sbyar ro// rgyas pa'i lam gyi mngon rtogs khrid// gnad kyi gdams pa bcu gcig las// khrid kyi lag len gnad drug la// nyams su blang thabs mdo tsam bkod/ gnad bcu gcig gis dkri ba'i khrid kyi gsal byed gnad kyi sgo 'byed ces bya ba/ btsun pa bsod nams kyis sbyar ba dge'o// 'di la'ang tshig khrid kyi srol med/ nyams khrid kho na yin gsung ngo*// shu bhaṃ/ ༈ /gnad drug gis dkri ba'i khrid kyi gsal byed gnad kyi lde'u mig ces bya ba/

bla ma dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal bir wa pa'i bzhed pa la rgyas 'bring gsum dang*/ zab 'bring gsum gang bstan yang don gyi gnad drug tu 'dus par bzhed de/ rgyu la gnas pa/ dbang las thob pa/ lam la goms pa/ lta ba la nyams myong skyes pa/ grub mtha' la rtags su shar ba/ 'bras bu la don ma lus pa mngon du gyur pa drug gis bsdus par bzhed la/ 'di nyams su len pa la gnyis kyi sngon 'gro la khrid kyi sngon 'gro/ bsags sbyang gnyis/ thun gyi sngon 'gro gnad la dbab pa gsum/ sgom pa gsum/ shes rab kyi bya ba la gsum ste dgu lam rgyas pa dang*/ dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi khrid ltar nyams su blang ste/ 'di ni khrid rim lnga char gyi sngon 'gror dgos pa'i chos yin no// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lam bzhi rim bzhin dkri ba dang*/ bum gsang shes rab ye shes dbang bzhi pa'i lam gyis dkri ba'o// dang po la bzhi las/ bum dbang gi lam la drug las/ rgyu la gnas pa ni thun gyi sngon 'gro gsum dang*/ sngon 'gro gsum sngon du song nas/ rten lus la rtsa 'khor lo bzhi/ gtso mo gsum ste/ rtsa rin po che'i pho brang bdun la/ brten pa kun gzhi gnyug ma me tog dang dri yi tshul gyis gnas (412)rten dang brten pa de gnyis ka la yang 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sa bon dang bag chags kyi tshul gyis tshang snyam pa'i nges shes bskyed/ de'i ngang la rtse gcig tu bzhag /rtog pa 'phro na 'khor 'das kyi snang ba gang shar yang rten dang brten pa lus sems lhan cig tu tshogs pa'i nang gi rten 'brel du shes par byas la lta ba bskyang*/ rjes la dge rtsa bsngo/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i rgyas gdab/ de ma rtogs kyi sems can la snying rje sgom pa'o// gnyis pa dbang las thob pa ni/ bla ma las bum dbang blang*/ bla ma mi bzhugs na dkyil 'khor bla ma dang tha mi dad pa dmigs pa las bum dbang rgyas par blang*/

dkyil 'khor/ dbang*/ slob dpon/ dri ma dag pa/ lam lta ba/ grub mtha' 'da' kha ma/ bar do/ brda/ dpe/ dam tshig /'bras bu rnams la nges shes bskyed do// gsum pa lam la goms pa ni/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa lha brgya lnga bcu rtsa bdun gsal btab/ dbang 'bring du blang ba'i tshigs bcad bzhis/ chu rgyun gcig las dbang bzhi rdzogs par blangs nas thugs rdo rje la bzung*/ de nas lte ba/ de nas gsang gnas/ de nas mgrin pa/ de nas spyi bo/ de nas yul yul can gyi lha bcu gnyis nas snod bcud lhar gsal ba'i bar la sems bzung ste/ ngo bo nyid gsum gyi nyams skyes skyes su sgom/ bzhi pa lta ba la nyams su myong ba ni/ sngar gyi nyams myong brtan par byed pa ste/ gzhung gi gdams ngag drug gi skabs bzhin du lta ba skyong ba ste/ don rang bzhin lhan skyes so// lnga pa grub mtha' la rtags su shar ba ni/ bskyed rim gyi lam bsgom pa las/ bum dbang sa drug la phyi nang de kho na nyid kyi rtags gsum gyis bsdus pa'i yon tan 'di lta bu skye'o snyam du gzhung nas bshad pa'i yon tan rnams dran pa'i tshul gyis rtags can lam la goms par byed pa'o/// /(413)drug pa 'bras bu la mngon du gyur pa ni sprul sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub ste yul snang stong zung 'jug tu shes pa yin la/ de'i ngang la rtse gcig tu 'jog pa yin la don rang bzhin lhan skyes so// de'ang bzhi/ lta ba/ grub mtha'/ mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bus bsdus pa'i sku bzhi lhun grub ste bzhir 'gyur ro// gnyis pa gsang dbang gi lam drug las/ rgyu la gnas pa ni/ rten ngag rtsa yi ge ste/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du yi ge bcu bzhi/ lte bar yi ge'i phyi mo brgyad/ ā li kā li lnga bcu tham pa brten pa kun gzhi me tog dang dri yi tshul du gnas pa sogs snga ma bzhin no// gnyis pa dbang las thob pa ni/ bla ma las gsang dbang la sogs pa snga ma bzhin sbyar ro// gsum pa lam la goms pa ni/

sbyong ba gsum rlung sbyor bdun/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa bco brgyad lam rgyas pa ltar thun nyer lngar bcad nas bsgom ste/ rang byung gi ye shes bzhi'i nyams gang rung skyes skyes kyi bar du nyams su blang ngo*// bzhi pa lta ba la nyams su myong ba ni/ sngar gyi nyams brtan par byed pa ste/ gzhung gi gdams ngag drug gi skabs bzhin du lta ba skyong ba yin la/ don rang rig lhan skyes so// de'i tshe shes pa gsal stong zung du ma chud na/ gnas khang cung zad dpangs mtho bar lus la sogs pa gnad la dbab la mig phye btsums ran par byas la/ gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin bcos min sems kyi ngo bo zhes bya ba thabs shes rab gnyis med zung 'jug tu shes par bya ste byung rgyal du bskyang ngo*// lnga pa grub mtha' la rtags su shar ba ni/ gsang dbang gi lam bsgoms pas gsang dbang sa bzhi la phyi nang sogs sngar ltar ro// drug pa 'bras bu la mngon du gyur pa ni/ longs sku rang bzhin gyi lhun grub ste shes pa (414)gsal stong zung 'jug tu rtogs pa rang rig lhan skyes yin la/ dbye na bzhir 'gyur tshul sngar bzhin no// gsum pa dbang gsum pa'i lam la drug las/ rgyu la gnas pa ni/ rten khams bdud rtsi la gnas pa ste/ byang chub kyi sems kyi khams dgu'i dwangs ma rtsa bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa kun gzhi sogs sngar bzhin sbyar ba la nges shes skyed do// gnyis pa dbang las thob pa ni/ bla ma las dbang gsum pa blang ba sogs snga ma bzhin sbyar ro// gsum pa lam la goms pa ni/ dbang gsum pa'i lam thun brgyad du bcad nas lam rgyas pa bzhin nyams su blang ste/ bde stong gi nyams skyes skyes sgom mo// bzhi pa lta ba la nyams su myong ba ni/ sngar gyi nyams brtan par byed pa ston/ gzhung gi gdams ngag drug gi skabs bzhin du bskyang ba yin la don zhu bde lhan skyes so// de'i tshe lus bde stong zung du chud nas/

sgom stor rkyen gyis btsal ba bzhin longs spyod kyi rlabs sam gsang ba'i snyoms 'jug gang rung la brten te skye'o// lnga pa grub mtha' rtags su shar ba dbang gsum pa'i lam la shes rab ye shes kyi sa gnyis la phyi nang sogs sbyar ba sngar ltar nyams su blang ngo*// drug pa 'bras bu la mngon du gyur pa ni/ chos sku rang bzhin lhun grub ste/ bde stong zung 'jug tu rtogs pa zhu bde lhan skyes yin la/ dbye na bzhir 'gyur ba sngar bzhin no// bzhi pa dbang bzhi pa'i lam la drug las/ rgyu la gnas pa ni/ rten dkyil 'khor gsum la khyab cing dbang byed pa'i snying po ye shes rlung la brten pa kun gzhi sogs sngar bzhin sbyar ba la nges shes bskyed do// gnyis pa dbang la thob pa ni/ bla ma la dbang bzhi pa la sogs sngar bzhin sbyar ro// gsum pa lam la goms pa ni/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam thun brgyad du bcad nas lam rgyas pa bzhin nyams su blang ste bde (415)stong mchog gi nyams skyes skyes bsgom mo// bzhi pa lta ba la nyams su myong ba ni/ sngar gyi nyams brtan par byed pa ste/ gzhung gi gdams ngag drug gi skabs ltar skyong ba yin la/ don rnam kun mchog ldan gyi lhan skyes so// lnga pa grub mtha' la rtags su shar ba ni/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam/ bzhi pa'i sa phyed la phyi nang de kho na nyid kyi rtags gsum gyis bsdus pa'i yon tan 'di lta bu skye'o zhes yon tan dran par byas nas rtags can la bsgom pa'i 'dun pa rtse gcig yang yang bskyed do// drug pa 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa ni ngo bo nyid sku rang bzhin lhun grub ste/ yul sems 'dus pa la sogs pas bsdus pa'i chos kun stong par rtogs pa rnam kun mchog ldan gyi lhan skyes te bzhir 'gyur tshul sngar bzhin no// de ltar na bum dbang la bcu gnyis/ gsang dbang la so gcig /dbang gsum pa dang bzhi pa la bcu gsum bcu gsum ste/

drug cu rtsa dgus lam khrid pa yin no// gnyis pa bum dbang gi lam gyis dkri ba la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ sngar dang 'dra ba las lam ma goms pa'i mjug tu/ de nas bum dbang gcig pus kyang lam thams cad mthar phyin pas na gzhan gsum rang gis 'byung ste/ lha gsal stong du rtogs pa gsang dbang gi lam/ bde stong du rtogs pas gsum pa'i lam/ snang gsal bde gsum gang yang zung du chud par rtogs pa bzhi pa'i lam du ngo sprod pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i skabs su sku bzhi lhun grub ste yul snang stong*/ shes pa gsal stong*/ lus bde stong*/ 'khor 'das thams cad rang stong du shes pa sprul longs chos ngo bo nyid sku ste/ rang bzhin rang rig zhu bde/ rnam kun mchog gi lhan skyes yin la/ de re re'ang bzhi/ lta ba/ grub mtha'/ mthar phyin gyis bsdus pa'i sku bzhi bzhir 'gyur bas bstan to// gsum pa gsang dbang gi lam gyis (416)dkri ba la/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi thun so gcig bcad pa sngar bzhin la/ lam gyi mjug tu nyams sna tshogs snang bzhin stong pa bum pa'i dbang gi lam/ bde bzhin du stong pa gsum pa'i lam/ zung 'jug bzhi pa'i lam mo zhes ngo sprad do// bzhi pa dbang gsum pa'i lam la sngon 'gro gnyis dang*/ dngos gzhi la lam gyi mgor rlung sbyor bdun bsnan/ mjug tu dga' ba bzhi'i lam du ye shes dbang bzhi'i lam du ngo sprad do// gzhan sngar bzhin sbyar bas dngos gzhi thun nyi shur bcad nas khrid pa'o// lnga pa bzhi pa'i lam la sngon 'gro gnyis/ dngos gzhi la lam skabs su sbyang ba gsum thun rer/ rlung sbyor bdun lus kyi rba rlabs/ ngag 'dren zhi drag gnyis skad cig gsum la thun re re byas la nyams su blang ste/ des na bzhi pa'i lam gcig pus kyang lam mthar phyin pas gzhan gsum ngang gis 'byung ste/ nyams snang stong snang bzhin du stong pa bum dbang gi lam/ gsal bzhin du stong pa gsang dbang lam/

snang rung gsal rung rang rang gi ngo bos stong pas ngos 'dzin gyis bskyed pa'i rdul med pas bde/ bde bzhin du stong pas gsum pa'i lam/ de ltar rang rang gi ngo bos stong pa de yang 'phral du byas pa ma yin gyi/ gdod nas dag par 'jug pas bzhi pa'i lam du ngo sprad do// gzhan bzhi pa'i lam sngar bzhin te/ thun nyer gcig gis khrid pa yin la/ sbyor rjes kyi chos sngar bstan pa ltar thun thams cad la sbyar ro// de dag las rim gyis dkri ba tshig khrid du'ang mdzad cing*/ rkang thon du dkri ba bzhi po 'di don khrid kho na yin la/ bzhi po 'di khrid rim gcig tu byed pa min gyi/ khrid rdzogs pa bzhi yin pas gang zag re re'i lam ma tshang ba med pa re re yin no// rgyas 'bring bsdus dang zab 'bring gsum// khrid tshul gnyis kyis gang zag gsum// dkri ba'i gnad kyi gdams ngag drug /(417)nyams len nyung gsal 'khrul med bkod/ gnad drug gis dkri ba'i khrid rim gyi gsal byed gnad kyi lde'u mig ces bya ba/ btsun pa bsod nams kyis sbyar ba'o// shu bhaṃ/ ༈ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyis dkri ba'i khrid rim gyi gsal byed nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma thugs rje chen po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon chen po bir wa pa'i bzhed pas lam la 'jug pa'i gang zag thams cad rigs bsdu na/ thabs kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i rnal 'byor pa gsum/ shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i rnal 'byor pa gsum/ thabs shes zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor pa ste bdun du bzhed la/ dang po la tha ma tshogs tsam gsog par 'dod pa/ 'bring po lam gyi thun bzhi la dbang bzhi len pa/ rab bzlas brjod sbyin sreg la brten nas las mtha' dag bsgrub par 'dod pa dang*/ gnyis pa la brtson pa tha ma chos bdag med tsam sgom pa/ 'bring bskyed rim la sems 'dzin pa/ rab rlung gi rnal 'byor la sems 'dzin pa gsum mo// de dag gang yang rung ba zhig bla ma'i drung du 'ong nas dbang dang dam tshig dang ldan par byas/

lha gang yin gyi bskyed rim dang*/ de'i snying po dang bcas pa de khrid kyis bskyang bar 'dod na ji ltar khrid tshul la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi gnyis las// dang po la chos bco lnga yod kyang bsdu na bcu gnyis su 'du bas/ dang por khrid kyi sngon 'gro la gsum ni/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs spyod pa yig brgya/ mthun pa'i phyogs tshogs bsags pa maṇ+ḍal/ nges 'byung skyed pa'i thabs 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa ste gzhung ji lta ba bzhin no// gnyis pa thun gyi sngon 'gro'i gnad la gsum/ sngon 'gro gsum/ shes rab kyi bya ba gsum ste/ thabs kyi bya ba gsum ni bar pa gsum du 'du bas nyams len la sogs pa med do// dang po bar pa ni/ byams snying (418)rje byang chub kyi sems sgom pa ste/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin no// gsum pa la chos thams cad sems/ sems sgyu ma/ sgyu ma rang bzhin med par thag bcad pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ thun gyi sngon 'gro drug sngon du song nas/ 'di ltar phyi nang gsang ba thams cad rang gi sems yin te/ phywa'am dbang phyug gis byas pa'am rdul phra rab las grub pa'am de bzhin gshegs pas sprul pa lta bu ma yin te/ dper na gnyid kyis bslad pa'i rmi lam la sogs pa bzhin du rang gi sems thog ma med pa nas las dang bag chags ngan pas bslad pa'i rnam pa yin gyis/ phyi nang grub pa gang yang med snyam du bsam/ de nas 'jog khar yang ngar re tsam rang gi sems gsal sing nge ba der bzhag go /zhag gsum mam lnga'am bdun la sogs par goms par bya'o// gnyis pa/ rmi lam/ sgyu ma/ gzugs brnyan/ mig yor bzhi la bslab ste/ de rnams kyi'ang sngon la mig yor la bslab/ mig g.yo gyis gnyis su snang ba de gcig bden na gcig brdzun pas gcig tu mi 'gro la/ ngos gcig bden na ngos gcig brdzun pas gcig tu thim 'gro ba bzhin no// de gnyis ka gang yang bden pa med de/ de bzhin du sems 'di yang mi bden par 'dug snyam du bsgom/

gzugs brnyan la gnyis te/ me long gi nang dang chu zla gnyis las/ de gnyis la 'di ltar bslab ste/ gzugs brnyan de yod du so sor yod pa rigs par mi 'dug /med na mi snang bar rigs pa la snang gin mi 'dug /de bzhin du sems kyang sgyu ma lta bur 'dug snyam du bsam mo// sgyu ma'ang rdzas kyi dngos po jo mo dang*/ spre'u mjug dang*/ gyi na la rta glang sogs snang ba dang*/ yod na bden par rigs/ med na mi snang bar rigs pa las snang ba ltar sems 'di sgyu ma ltar 'dug snyam du bsam/ de ltar rmi lam la bsams pas sgyu mar 'dug par sgro 'dogs chod/ des sems la bden 'dzin ldog go /de ltar dpe bzhi so so re re (419)la zhag gsum gsum tsam re bslab ste zhas bcu gnyis tsam re bslab gsung ngo*// gsum pa ni/ rang bzhin med pa zhes bya ba ni ngo bo med pa gtad med pa zhig la zer ba yin te/ des na sgyu ma rang bzhin med par blos thag bcad la de'i ngang la cung zad bzhag go /de dag thag bcad pa gsum mo// de ltar sngon 'gro de dag sngon du song nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis las/ thabs kyi phyogs su lhungs pa'i rnal 'byor pa gsum gyis brtson pa tha ma la rigs gnyis las/ rdo rje slob dpon dbang las ma thob pas ni/ sngon 'gro dgu sngon du song bas lha dpa' bo gcig pa bsgom/ thugs rje'i 'od zer gyi spro bsdus snod bcud dkyil 'khor dang lha gsal btab nas de'i bzlas pa byed pa'o// rjes 'og ltar ngo bo nyid gsum dran par byas nas gtor ma la sogs pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyis dus 'da' bar bya'o// de lta bu thun gcig gam gnyis sam gsum la sogs pa gang 'grub byed cing lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom yang legs/ ma bsgoms kyang 'gal ba med do// de nas 'og ltar lta bas rgyas gdab bo// slob dpon gyi dbang thob pa yin na/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa yin la gzhan snga ma dang 'dra'o// brtson pa 'bring gis sngon 'gro dgu zin nas tshogs kyi zhing spyan drangs pa nas brtsams te/

ye shes pa gzhug pa'i bar rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bsgom/ de nas lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal btab nas sems zhogs tshad cig 'jog /rjes sngar dang 'dra/ de nas rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung zhig blang*/ de nas ngo bo nyid gsum bsgom ste/ lhar snang ba snang phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid/ de rang bzhin med pa stong phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid/ de gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid do// zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid la blo cung zad bzhag la/ de nas bzlas pa byed dam mi byed rang gang mos bya/ langs nas 'gro na rjes (420)kyi ngo bo nyid gsum dran par byas nas 'gro ste/ dkar dmar du snang ba snang phyogs/ de rang bzhin med pa stong phyogs/ de gnyis dbyer med pa zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid de/ de ltar dran par byas la spyod lam bya'o// de ltar na thun bzhi kho nar grangs nges pa dang*/ lta ba ngo bo nyid bskyang ba ni ci nas kyang bsgom mo// gtor ma thun thams cad la ma 'byor na'ang thun tha ma la re re med ka med yin// brtson pa rab la gsum las/ lha bsgom pa'i tshul dang lta ba bskyang ba ni snga ma dang 'dra ba thun bzhi'i mjug tu byed la/ gtso bo ni lta ba bskyang ba yin no// las tshogs bsgrub pa ni/ bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bzhi dang*/ sbyin sreg khri phrag bzhi byas la rgyud las gsungs pa'i las tshogs bsgrub pa ste/ de tsam gyis ma grub na/ slar yang de tsam gcig bya/ des kyang ma grub na de tsam gcig bya ste/ mdor na bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bcu gnyis/ sbyin sreg khri phrag bcu gnyis byas nas las bsgrub pa'o// shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i gang zag la'ang gsum las/ brtson pa tha ma ni/ sngon 'gro dgu sngar dang 'dra bar byas la/ dngos gzhi la gsum las/ gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid ngos bzung ba ni/ phyi nang gang la bltas kyang gsal ba'i ngo bor 'dug pa de la cher bltas nas de'i ngang la rtog pa med par 'jog pa'o// de lta bu thun grangs med pas mnyam gzhag la bsgom zhing*/

rjes dge rtsa bsngo/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i rgyas gdab/ de ma rtogs kyi sems can la snying rje bsgom mo// gnyis pa stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin ngos gzung ba ni/ phyi nang gang la bltas kyang rang bzhin gyis stong ste gnas pa lus kyi nang na yang mi 'dug /phyi rol na yang mi 'dug /dbyings la bltas na dbyings la yang mi 'dug la/ des na rang bzhin stong par 'dug pa de'i ngang la cher bltas nas rtog pa med par 'jog pa'o// rjes snga ma dang 'dra'o// gsum pa bcos min sems kyi ngo bo ngos gzung ba ni/ de ltar mnyam par gzhag pa'i dus na/ gsal ba'i dus nyid na stong*/ stong pa'i dus nyid na gsal bas gsal stong gi ngo bo de la ma bcos (421)par nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu la sems 'jog pa'o// rjes snga ma dang 'dra'o// brtson pa 'bring gis ni/ sngon 'gro dgu sngon du song nas/ dngos gzhi la gsum las/ lha bsgom pa ni/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa nas brtsams te/ rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab pa'i bar gsal zhing drag la yun thung bar thun bzhi la sogs par nyams su blangs nas de la sems cung zad 'jog pa'o// rjes ngo bo nyid gsum bskyang ste snga ma dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa dbang blang ba ni/ lam dus kyi dbang rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig len pa'o// gsum pa sems gzung ba la spyi la sems gzung ba dang*/ bye brag la sems gzung ba la gnyis las/ dang po la bzhi las/ bsgom pa gsal gdab pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo tsam la dmigs nas gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad/ mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro bcad/ ces pa'i tshul gyis bsgom/ de ltar byas kyang mi gsal na/ rang gi brjod pas gsal gdab pa ni/ spyan dbu ma spyan rtsa khro zhing dmar ba zhes brjod la snga ma bzhin du bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung zhing bsgom/ des kyang mi gsal na gzhan gyis brjod pas gsal gdab pa ni/ gzhan gcig /spyan dbu ma zhes brjod du bcug la/

yang bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung la bsgom/ des kyang mi gsal na bltas pas gsal gdab ces bya ba spyan dbu ma shin tu mdzes pa zhig bris la de la bltas nas bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung zhing bsgom mo// gnyis pa bye brag la sems bzung tshul la phyi nas 'dzin pa dang nang nas 'dzin pa lugs gnyis las/ dang po ltar na lam rgyas pa ltar rang gi spyan dbu ma nas brtsam ste snod bcud lhar gsal ba'i bar la sems 'dzin la/ gnyis pa ltar na dbu'i gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo gsal gdab pa nas brtsams te pho brang drug gi lha nas snod bcud lhar gsal la rim gyis sems 'dzin te/ bzung ba'i thabs ni snga ma bzhin no// bzung tshul gnyis pa 'di rang (422)gi blo la gar 'phrod pa de bsgom gyi/ gnyis pa bsgom dgos pa ni ma yin no// rjes snga ma dang 'dra'o// rnal 'byor nang la mchog tu gzhol ba yis ni bzlas pa dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ mdo zlos la sogs mi byed par mnyam gzhag bskyed rim la sems bzung zhing goms nas rjes kyi lta ba dang bsre gsung bas ngo bo nyid gsum bsgom zhing*/ thun bzhi la sogs par nyams su len pa'o// brtson pa rab kyis/ sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra bar byas nas/ dngos gzhi la nyams len gyi bye brag zhe lnga las/ gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin/ bcos min sems kyi ngo bo gsum ni snga ma dang 'dra la/ de nas sbyang ba khyad par can gyi gnad la/ lus sbyang ba zla ba drug sngon du 'gro dgos te/ de'i sngon du mthun rkyen dang 'gal rkyen gyi gsag sbyang gnyis sngon du song nas/ gnas dben par nyi zer dang lhags pa med pa/ sa bde bar stan 'bol ba rgya che ba'i steng du sngon 'gro gsum byas la/ phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis dang po yas rim du tshar gcig /de nas mas rim du tshar gcig/ gang zin nas thams cad tshang bar tshar gcig ste de ltar dgu bcu rtsa drug drug thun re la bya ste/

de lta bu thun gsum mam gnyis sam gcig gang 'grub zla ba drug tu bya'o// de'ang skye ba 'di la dngos grub thob par 'dod na lus sbyang ba gnad du che ba yin gsung ngo*// de nas ngag sems sbyang ba lam rgyas pa ltar bya/ srog rtsol la sogs pa sngon du song nas 'og rlung skyod pa lus kyi rba rlabs kyi gnad ni rlung sbyor bdun/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa bco brgyad la lam rgyas pa ltar bsgom/ de dag gi skabs bogs 'byin brgyad kyi gnad kyis bogs dbyung ngo*// de nas 'og rlung skyod pa lus kyi rba rlabs dngos/ de nas ngag 'dren pa zhi ba'i gnad/ de nas ngag 'dren pa drag po'i gnad/ de nas lta ba gso ba phyag rgya chen po'i gnad/ dbang gsum pa'i lam ste lam rgyas pa'i gzhung dang 'dra la de nas ting nge 'dzin sems kyi rba rlabs kyi gnad de gzhung ji lta ba'o// da ni thun gyi nges pa bri bar bya ste/ gang zag thams cad la dgos pa'i sngon 'gro la gnyis las/ khrid kyi sngon 'gro la gsag sbyang gnyis/ 'khor ba'i (423)nyes dmigs bsam pa gsum/ thun gyi sngon 'gro la lus ngag yid gsum gnad la dbab pa gsum/ sngon 'gro gsum las byams pa sgom ba la gsum/ snying rje la gsum/ byang chub kyi sems sgom pa la lnga/ shes rab kyis bya ba la thag bcad pa la gsum ste thun nyi shu'o// dngos gzhi'i thabs kyi tha ma la lha bsgom pa dang lta bas rgyas gdab pa gnyis/ 'bring la lha bskyed pa/ dbang blang gi rgyas gdab pa ste gsum/ rab la lha sgom/ lta ba bskyang*/ las tshogs sgrub pa ste gsum mo// shes rab kyi tha ma la/ gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin/ bcos min sems kyi ngo bo ste gsum/ 'bring la lha sgom pa/ dbang blang ba/ spyi la sems bzung ba la bzhi/ bye brag tu sems bzung ba la gcig ste lnga/ rab la gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid/ stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin/ bcos min sems kyi ngo bo ste gsum/

sbyang ba khyad par can gyi gnad la gsum/ rlung sbyor bdun/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa bco brgyad/ lus kyi rba rlabs/ ngag 'dren zhi ba/ drag po/ gsum pa'i lam la sngon 'gro lam bsdus pa bzhin bya/ dngos gzhi la bslab tshul lnga/ mnyam par sbyar ba bslab tshul te brgyad do// rjes ni zhar byung ngo*// sems kyi rba rlabs la gsum ste/ thun zhe lnga'o// gang zag dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi khrid// rje btsun bla ma'i gsung dang mi 'gal bar// gsal bar bgyis la nongs pa bzod mdzad cing*// dge bas lhan skyes ye shes mthar phyin shog /dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyis dkri ba'i khrid rim gyi gsal byed nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba 'di/ bsam gtan pa shākya bzang po zhes bya bas yang yang du bskul ba'i ngor btsun pa bsod nams kyis sbyar ba dge'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ/ (424)
